items.title: 黃仁勳走了還沒完！美財長開砲商務部 輝達也得說清楚
items.title_en: Nvidia’s Turmoil Continues After Jensen Huang’s Exit: Treasury Secretary Slams Commerce Dept, Nvidia Must Clarify
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)風波進一步延燒至川普政府內部。據《金融時報》與《彭博》報導，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)公開表示，財政部等多個部門數月來一直支持將Megaspeed列入貿易黑名單，但決策權掌握在商務部手中。他也要求追究輝達相關人員的責任，質疑公司是否充分查核客戶並防止晶片流入中國。
這番發言讓商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)承受更大壓力。Megaspeed涉嫌將輝達晶片走私至中國的調查已持續一年多，而黃仁勳因涉及與美方懷疑具有中國情報背景的黃樂(Alice Huang)發生婚外情而辭任，使晶片出口審查與企業內控問題成為華府焦點。

多部門早支持列入黑名單 貝森特將矛頭指向商務部

貝森特接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，財政部、美國貿易代表署及國務院，數月來都贊成將Megaspeed列入實體清單，但「主導權在商務部」，外界應向商務部詢問內部處理程序。
《金融時報》本周稍早報導，商務部曾延後將Megaspeed列入黑名單的相關作業。實體清單是美國出口管制工具之一，美國企業若要向名單內公司出口受管制產品，須取得商務部許可，以防先進技術落入中國軍方手中。
對於是否曾就此事與盧特尼克當面交鋒，貝森特未正面回應，僅表示：「我們不會重述戰情室內的對話。」
貝森特說，川普已明確表示，中國不應取得比H100更先進的輝達晶片，因此任何外流都令人沮喪，既傷害美國企業，也可能讓中國在AI競賽中取得優勢。
被問及是否需要改變晶片出口政策時，他強調，政府已具備所需權限，重點是落實執行，暗示問題並非缺乏管制工具，而是現有措施是否確實執行。

國會施壓盧特尼克 輝達客戶審查也遭追問

國會對商務部的壓力同步升高。共和黨議員要求盧特尼克赴國會作證，民主黨高層則要求他保存相關文件，以供後續調查。據《彭博》報導，盧特尼克已同意作證。
參議院銀行委員會民主黨首席議員華倫要求，盧特尼克必須說明為何尚未堵住出口管制漏洞，並立即採取行動，確保美國先進技術不會助長中國軍力。不過，川普目前仍公開支持盧特尼克，在輝達宣布黃仁勳辭職後表達對他的信任。
貝森特也將問責焦點指向輝達，質疑公司是否真正了解客戶，以及是否採取充分措施，確保晶片沒有外流、買家並非僅供轉手交易的空殼公司。他表示，公司內應對相關問題負責的人，都必須受到追究。
此外，貝森特點名曾介入美國政府調查Megaspeed涉嫌走私AI晶片案的輝達法務長Tim Teter，批評他應加強監督，而非一味責難調查。他並預期，輝達董事會將對事件展開徹底調查。
上述發言進一步擴大問責範圍，但貝森特對客戶審查與晶片外流的質疑，並不等同於已認定輝達或相關人員違法。
paras_en: The Nvidia (NVDA-US) controversy has further spread within the Trump administration. According to the Financial Times and Bloomberg, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly said that the Treasury and several other agencies have been supporting the inclusion of Megaspeed on the trade blacklist for months, but the decision authority rests with the Commerce Department. He also called for holding Nvidia personnel accountable, questioning whether the company has adequately vetted customers and prevented chips from flowing to China.

The remarks put Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick under greater pressure. The investigation into Megaspeed’s alleged smuggling of Nvidia chips to China has been ongoing for more than a year, and Jensen Huang’s resignation amid allegations of an affair with Alice Huang, who is suspected of having Chinese intelligence ties, has made chip export reviews and corporate internal controls a focus in Washington.

Multiple agencies had early support for blacklisting Megaspeed; Bessent points the finger at Commerce. In an interview with CNBC, Bessent said the Treasury, the U.S. Trade Representative’s office and the State Department have for months agreed to place Megaspeed on the Entity List, but “the lead authority is the Commerce Department,” and outsiders should ask Commerce about its internal procedures.

The Financial Times reported earlier this week that Commerce had delayed actions to add Megaspeed to the blacklist. The Entity List is one of the U.S. export‑control tools; U.S. firms must obtain a Commerce Department license to export controlled products to listed companies, to prevent advanced technology from reaching the Chinese military.
When asked whether he had confronted Lutnick directly about the matter, Bessent gave no direct answer, saying only, “We will not repeat the dialogue that took place in the war room.”

Bessent said Trump has made it clear that China should not obtain Nvidia chips more advanced than the H100, so any leakage is disappointing, harming U.S. companies and potentially giving China an edge in the AI race.

When questioned about whether chip‑export policy needs to change, he emphasized that the government already has the necessary authority; the issue is implementation, implying the problem is not a lack of tools but whether existing measures are being enforced.

Congress ramps up pressure on Lutnick; Nvidia’s customer vetting also comes under scrutiny. Republican lawmakers are demanding Lutnick testify before Congress, while senior Democrats want him to preserve relevant documents for further investigation. Bloomberg reports that Lutnick has agreed to testify.

Senate Banking Committee Democratic Chair Warren has asked Lutnick to explain why export‑control gaps have not been closed and to act immediately to ensure U.S. advanced technology does not bolster Chinese military power. However, Trump continues to publicly back Lutnick, expressing confidence in him after Nvidia announced Huang’s resignation.

Bessent also shifted accountability onto Nvidia, questioning whether the company truly understands its customers and has taken sufficient steps to ensure chips do not leak and that buyers are not merely shell companies for resale. He said anyone at Nvidia responsible for these issues must be held accountable.

He further singled out Nvidia’s chief legal officer Tim Teter, who had been involved in the government’s investigation of Megaspeed’s alleged AI‑chip smuggling, criticizing him for needing to strengthen oversight rather than merely blaming the probe, and he expects Nvidia’s board to conduct a thorough investigation.
These comments broaden the scope of accountability, but Bessent’s doubts about customer vetting and chip leakage do not equate to a legal finding that Nvidia or its personnel have violated the law.

items.title: 黃仁勳突卸輝達執行長震撼矽谷 Twitter前CEO預測他3年後王者歸來
paras: 人工智慧(AI)革命的核心領航者、掌舵輝達(Nvidia)長達33年的創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳，周四(12日)正式辭去執行長職務。這起震撼矽谷與全球資本市場的重大人事變動，不僅終結了科技史上最具代表性的創辦人治理時代之一，更引發了關於「創辦人不可替代性」、公司治理界線、併購案變數以及輝達未來估值的激烈辯論。

33年創辦人帝國的驟然更迭

自 1993 年在矽谷一家平價餐廳與夥伴共同創立輝達以來，黃仁勳一直是這家晶片巨擘唯一的執行長。在他33年的領導下，輝達從一家專注於 3D 繪圖晶片的初創企業，一步步轉型為支撐全球 AI 算力基礎設施的市值龍頭。然而，根據知情人士透露，輝達董事會在收到包含涉及與涉嫌為中國從事情報活動的女性以及公司內部員工的兩起緋聞舉報後，決定解除黃仁勳的職務。
董事會隨後指派輝達長期擔任財務長的科萊特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)接任代理執行長，以期在風暴中穩住經營大局。
黃仁勳的離去消息一出，科技界、華爾街與政治圈無不震驚，紛紛聚焦於這究竟是輝達董事會的合規自救，還是一場無法挽回的歷史性戰略失誤。

矽谷創投與科技圈巨頭的集體陣痛與分歧

黃仁勳在科技界的影響力早已超越單一企業執行長，更被視為全球 AI 產業的非官方大使。因此，其下台在矽谷創投界與創業家群體中引發了極大的陣痛與強烈反彈。
許多知名投資人與企業家將此事件視為破壞科技創新生態的嚴重錯誤：
Martin Casado(Andreessen Horowitz 一般合夥人)：在社交平台 X 上直言這是「極其黑暗的一天」，並形容為「對美國與西方世界極其糟糕的決定」。他更公開表示，若黃仁勳願意加入 Andreessen Horowitz，將是無上的榮幸。
Tobi Lütke(Shopify 創辦人兼執行長)：警告此舉是「世代級的重大失誤」(generational blunder)，並指出輝達未來極可能淪為黃仁勳所創造之偉大公司的拙劣模仿者，強調：「沒有人能夠替代像黃仁勳這樣的創辦人。」
Naval Ravikant(知名風險投資人)：引用蘋果解僱賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)與 Uber 逼走卡蘭尼克(Travis Kalanick)的歷史先例，反問產業界是否仍未汲取「創辦人無法被輕易替換」的歷史教訓。對此，SpaceX 與特斯拉執行長 Elon Musk 亦在下方簡短回應「所言甚是」(True words)，並轉載電影《AIR》經典台詞向黃仁勳致敬。
Stephen Witt(黃仁勳傳記作者)：在接受 CNBC 專訪時指出，黃仁勳即代表了輝達本身，就如同芝加哥公牛隊失去了麥可·喬丹(Michael Jordan)。他特別提到，黃仁勳能夠單憑記憶徒手畫出輝達設備中每一個零件的爆炸圖，這種對技術與產品細節的掌控力在業界根本找不到替代者。
Raj Gokal(Solana Labs 共同創辦人)：將董事會的決定評為「世代級的失誤」(generational fumble)。
Alex Bouaziz(Deel 執行長)：直接判定輝達董事會的決策是一個「錯誤」。
Cristóbal Valenzuela(Runway AI 共同創辦人)與 Sarah Guo(Conviction 創辦人)：一致認為黃仁勳的離去對整個 AI 產業是「巨大的損失」。

業界情感致敬與聲援

除批評董事會決策外，多位科技領袖亦表達了對黃仁勳三十三年貢獻的敬意。Perplexity AI 創辦人 Aravind Srinivas 感謝黃仁勳勇敢領導輝達躍升為美國最有價值的企業，並為無數 AI 創業家奠定基礎；幣安創辦人 趙長鵬(CZ) 坦言輝達放走黃仁勳絕對是錯誤；Epic Games 創辦人 Tim Sweeney 表示這是輝達、開發者與全人類的悲哀之日。
知名播客主持人 Lex Fridman 則發長文指出，在接觸過數百名工程師與 CEO 後，未曾聽聞有人對黃仁勳有過負面評價，堅定表示「我站在黃仁勳這邊」。前高盛執行長 Lloyd Blankfein 則引述戴高樂的名言感歎這是一場莎士比亞式的悲劇，但也提醒「墓地裡躺滿了不可或缺的人」。

併購案生變與前沿技術生態系的連帶衝擊

黃仁勳突遭解職，迅速對輝達正處於推進階段的重大戰略佈局與前沿技術投資產生連帶連鎖反應。
其中最受矚目的，是輝達原計畫以 130 億美元(或 129 億美元)收購知名開源 AI 平台 Hugging Face 的交易。Hugging Face 執行長 Clement Delangue 在社交媒體上坦言：「整件事非常糟糕，我希望這一切從未發生。」
但他隨即強調，無論高層如何變動，Hugging Face 都將比以往更加努力地為開源 AI 事業奮鬥。這筆高額併購案是否會因黃仁勳的缺席而陷入停滯或生變，已成為開源社群高度關注的焦點。
此外，紅杉資本(Sequoia Capital)合夥人 Shaun Maguire 特別指出，輝達近年在黃仁勳主導下，大幅加碼對「開放原始碼(Open Source)」、「光子學(Photonics)」以及「機器人學(Robotics)」等前沿領域的投資與研發。
Maguire 警告，隨著黃仁勳的離職，這些高度仰賴其個人戰略願景與資源支持的關鍵技術領域，都將深刻感受到失去領導者的重大衝擊。

公司治理教訓與資本市場的兩極化戰線

黃仁勳離職引發的市場地震，迅速將資本市場與治理專家劃分為立場鮮明的兩大戰線。
對於企業高層的劇烈變動，知名風險投資人 Elad Gil 從公司治理的公司運作角度提出警示：「企業應在順境時重置董事會，以避免在逆境時採取突兀的極端行動。」因陷入爭議而於 2017 年迫於壓力辭職的 Uber 前執行長 Travis Kalanick 在互動中對此觀點表示贊同，顯示出矽谷對於創辦人與董事會權力制衡機制的集體反思。

資本市場的看法對比

投資人與 Wall Street 分析師對輝達後續股價與基本面的看法呈現顯著分歧：
Leo KoGuan(新加坡億萬富豪，持股約13億美元)：
「沒有黃仁勳，我不會再增持股票。」主張美國是創造者文明，痛批董事會將監管者凌駕於創造者之上。
Dan Ives(Wedbush 分析師)：
認為董事會別無選擇，但目標價急劇下修：「有黃仁勳的輝達價值 300 美元，沒有他則僅值 225 美元。」
Jim Cramer(CNBC 主持人)：
支持董事會決定，認為舉證過多別無選擇，並高度讚賞代理執行長 Colette Kress 能穩定經營局勢。
Ross Gerber(Gerber Kawasaki 執行長)：
將此時刻類比為賈伯斯離開蘋果，認為 AI 趨勢與輝達發展仍將繼續，此時低點未必是終點。
段永平(知名投資人)：
表態不會賣出股票並賣出大量認售選擇權(Puts)，預測黃仁勳未來可能轉任顧問扮演「影子CEO」，保留實質影響力。

3年回歸預言與輝達的下一步

儘管眼前的風暴尚未平息，科技界已開始議論黃仁勳重返輝達的可能性。
Twitter 前執行長 Dick Costolo 預測，3到4年後，輝達將會有一兩個季度的業績不及市場預期，屆時董事會將會把黃仁勳請回來重新掌舵公司。就像名人的醜聞一樣，大眾憤慨15分鐘後就會淡忘，而美國人最喜歡的，莫過於王者歸來的傳奇故事。」

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉輝達回穩、PPI數據助攻 主要指數漲跌不一
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Early Session: Nvidia Stabilizes, PPI Data Helps, Major Indices Mixed
paras: 美股周五(13日)早盤主要指數漲跌不一。10月生產者物價指數(PPI)月增幅略低於預期，緩解市場對聯準會(Fed)可能大幅升息的擔憂；輝達(NVDA-US)也在近期高層人事風波引發的跌勢後回穩反彈，為市場提供支撐，但未能帶動主要指數同步走高。
歷經本周震盪，標普500指數仍可望寫下8月以來最大單周漲幅，債市則以短天期美債表現較佳。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近130點或近0.2%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近20點或0.5%，標普 500 指數跌0.02%，費城半導體指數跌近1.5%，台積電ADR漲0.03%。
美股周五走高，最新通膨數據略低於預期，緩解市場對聯準會(Fed)可能大幅升息的擔憂，為本周震盪不安的華爾街帶來喘息空間。
儘管過去幾天市場走勢多有波折，標普500指數仍可望寫下8月以來最大單周漲幅。先前因高層人事風波遭到重挫的輝達(NVDA-US)，周五股價也反彈；美債市場則以短天期公債表現較佳。
美國10月生產者物價指數(PPI)年增率升至2022年以來最高，但本次公布的月增幅略低於市場預期，讓交易員稍微鬆了一口氣。這也顯示，市場短線關注的不只是通膨水準仍高，更在意數據是否足以促使Fed採取更激進的升息行動。
BMO Capital Markets資本市場策略師Vail Hartman指出，雖然Fed在抑制通膨方面仍有許多工作要做，但PPI中會納入央行偏好通膨指標的部分細項，10月表現較弱，有助緩解市場疑慮。Fed偏好的通膨指標為個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)。
不過，官員對物價壓力仍保持警戒。紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯在數據公布前表示，通膨依然偏高，決策官員必須採取進一步行動，才能抑制價格壓力。

昨日因黃仁勳辭職收跌超4%的輝達，今日美股盤前拉升漲逾1.4%。消息面上，部分輝達員工正呼籲董事會重新考慮黃仁勳回歸執行長的可能性。

paras: 材料-KY(4763-TW)2026年下半年來營收已站穩10億元大關，公司今(13)日公布最新財報獲利資訊，材料-KY在2026年第三季營收回升到31.23億元，毛利率也回升到48%，季增7.11個百分點，但因自中國大陸匯出資金扣繳稅款達9.63億元影響，導致單季近損益兩平，2026年1-3季稅後純益18.29億元，每股純益1.85元。
展現跨區域、多元化發展的強大企圖心的材料-KY指出，對2026年第四季營收展望持審慎樂觀看法，將持續關注客戶庫存、終端需求與全球貿易環境，彈性調整營運步調，並依規劃推進Cerdia交易相關作業，深化全球布局與產品組合，提升長期競爭力。

材料-KY在全球布局方面，材料-KY已於2026年9月21日宣布，董事會通過與黑石集團（Blackstone）旗下管理基金簽署股份購買協議及股份交換契約，擬以現金及股票對價取得Cerdia Holding 100%股權。Cerdia擁有逾百年纖維素材料製造經驗，全球員工約1,100人，並於歐洲及美洲設有生產基地。待交易完成後，濟南大自然新材料營運據點將由中國延伸至德國、美國、巴西及俄羅斯，涵蓋亞洲、歐洲、北美洲與南美洲。公司預期，結合雙方生產據點、客戶基礎與研發能力，將有助提升生產調度、原料配置及客戶服務彈性，強化因應關稅、物流及地緣政治變化的能力。
paras_en: Materials‑KY (4763‑TW) has already secured revenue above NT$10 billion in the second half of 2026. The company announced its latest financial results today (13th). In Q3 2026, Materials‑KY’s revenue rose to NT$31.23 billion and its gross margin recovered to 48%, up 7.11 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter. However, a withholding tax of NT$9.63 billion on profit remitted from its mainland China subsidiary offset the gain, leaving the quarter essentially break‑even. For the first three quarters of 2026, after‑tax net profit was NT$18.29 billion, or NT$1.85 per share.

Materials‑KY, which demonstrates strong ambition for cross‑regional and diversified growth, said it holds a cautiously optimistic outlook for Q4 2026 revenue. It will continue to monitor customer inventories, end‑user demand and the global trade environment, flexibly adjust its operating pace, and proceed with the planned Cerdia transaction to deepen its global footprint and product portfolio, enhancing long‑term competitiveness.

In Q3 2026, Materials‑KY posted revenue of NT$31.23 billion, a gross margin of 48%, a quarter‑over‑quarter increase of 7.11 percentage points and a year‑over‑year decline of 12.33 percentage points. Net profit for the period was NT$9.51 million, with a small loss attributable to the parent of NT$2.04 million, essentially breakeven.

For the January‑September 2026 period, Materials‑KY recorded revenue of NT$86.78 billion, a gross margin of 48.04% (down 10.77 percentage points year‑over‑year), after‑tax net profit of NT$18.29 billion (down 62.56% year‑over‑year), and earnings of NT$1.85 per share.

Q3 2026 revenue of NT$31.23 billion grew 27.6% from the same quarter last year and 9.8% from the prior quarter. The growth was driven by downstream customers completing inventory adjustments of over a year, bringing industry inventory levels back toward normal and prompting restocking demand. The margin rebound was mainly because Q2 had higher unit costs due to an expanded scope of repairs by some subsidiaries; once that effect faded, the consolidated gross margin rose from 40.9% in Q2 to 48%, a gain of 7.11 percentage points.

Operating profit for Q3 2026 was NT$12.41 billion, up 27.8% from the prior quarter. The operating expense ratio rose to 8.2% from 6.7% a quarter earlier, a 1.5‑point increase. The expense rise stemmed from continued pressure in the traditional peak shipping season, tighter shipping capacity due to supply‑chain detours and port congestion, which lifted ocean freight rates versus Q2, together with a higher share of ocean‑freight exports in Q3, driving up selling expenses.

Net profit for the quarter was NT$9.51 million, a sharp decline from the prior quarter, mainly because of acquisition‑related activities. The mainland China subsidiary’s earnings were remitted abroad, and a statutory withholding tax of US$30.35 million (approximately NT$9.63 billion) was deducted. This one‑off tax impact reduced Q3 after‑tax profit versus Q2 but did not affect the core operating health. The company will continue cost‑optimization and operational‑resilience initiatives to capture inventory‑replenishment opportunities, solidifying its leading position and core profitability in the acetate fiber industry.

Materials‑KY maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook for Q4 revenue, will keep monitoring customer inventories, end‑user demand and the global trade environment, flexibly adjust its operating pace, and advance the planned Cerdia transaction to deepen its global footprint and product mix, thereby enhancing long‑term competitiveness.

In October 2026, Materials‑KY generated NT$10.52 billion in revenue, the second‑highest monthly figure of the year, up 2.69% month‑over‑month and 33.07% year‑over‑year. For the January‑October period, revenue totaled NT$97.29 billion, down 13.53% year‑over‑year.

Regarding its global expansion, Materials‑KY announced on 21 September 2026 that its board approved a share‑purchase agreement and share‑exchange contract with a Blackstone‑managed fund to acquire 100% of Cerdia Holding for cash and stock. Cerdia brings over a century of cellulose material manufacturing experience, about 1,100 employees worldwide, and production sites in Europe and the Americas. Upon completion, the Jinan Natural New Materials operation will extend from China into Germany, the United States, Brazil and Russia, covering Asia, Europe, North America and South America. The company expects that combining the two firms’ production sites, customer bases and R&D capabilities will improve production scheduling, raw‑material allocation and customer‑service flexibility, strengthening its ability to cope with tariffs, logistics and geopolitical shifts.

items.title: 川普點名庫克接棒黃仁勳！分析師打臉「機率幾乎為零」 蘋果前執行長為何不該掌舵輝達？
items.title_en: Trump Names Cook to Succeed Jensen Huang! Analysts Say the Chance Is Near Zero
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳捲入婚外情並違反公司行為準則，周四(12日)黯然請辭下台，幾小時過後，與他頗有交情的美國總統川普發文點名蘋果(AAPL-US)前執行長庫克(Tim Cook)接棒，引發熱烈討論。
黃仁勳周四請辭下台後，已由財務長克雷斯(Colette Kress)暫代執行長職務，但輝達尚未確定正式接班人選。
川普周四在Truth Social上發文表示：「既然輝達執行長Jensen Huang已經辭職，而且他原本做得非常出色，接替他的只有一個人──蘋果的庫克。一位傳奇人物接替另一位傳奇人物！」
庫克擔任蘋果執行長長達15年，直到9月1日卸任，由特納斯(John Ternus)接任，目前庫克仍擔任蘋果董事會的執行董事長。

川普看好庫克 分析師認為接任機率極低

庫克在擔任蘋果掌門人的最後兩年，與川普政府建立了密切關係，尤其蘋果承諾未來四年在美國投入數千億美元投資，有助於鞏固雙方關係。
River Wealth Advisor執行長暨管理合夥人Ed O’Gorman說：「庫克擔任蘋果執行長期間，川普與他建立了直接且務實的合作關係，因此川普可能對這段關係感到放心。他也可能認為，庫克接替賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)出任執行長後的成就，證明他有能力接任。」
然而，庫克接下輝達執行長一職的可能性極低。O’Gorman說：「儘管相關新聞引發關注，預測市場也曾短暫出現交易熱度，但這件事實際發生的機率幾乎是零。」
他指出，蘋果與輝達的業務性質截然不同。蘋果是全球最大的消費科技公司，輝達則是製造為科技硬體提供運算能力的晶片。庫克擅長的領域，未必能直接轉化為經營輝達所需的能力。
Equity Armor Investments投資組合經理Joe Tigay也持相同看法，他說：「庫克是一個令人安心的人選，是經過驗證的營運及外交型領導者，也是川普知道如何打交道的人。但我認為，他轉任輝達的可能性非常低。我們應該把這件事視為川普提出的一個人選，而不是當成既定事實，也不應假設這反映了輝達董事會或庫克本人的意願。」

業務基因不同、AI作風過於保守

庫克被視為成功的企業主管，在他擔任執行長期間，蘋果股價飆漲約20倍。他曾推出多項令人印象深刻的產品，包括AirPods與Apple Watch，也大幅改造公司的服務業務。如今的蘋果以黏著度極高的生態系聞名，消費者持續回購產品及使用服務。
《巴隆周刊》(Barron’s)認為，如果庫克選在此時轉而接掌一家正陷入動盪的企業，可能拖累他多年來努力建立的聲譽。
庫克也因蘋果在AI領域的布局受到一些批評。蘋果與AI實驗室合作，推動Apple Intelligence更新，但目前已推出的功能尚未讓消費者眼睛一亮。特納斯接任執行長後所面臨的艱鉅任務之一，就是證明這些AI更新確實有效。
O’Gorman說：「庫克在蘋果應用AI方面相當謹慎，但輝達已經建立起一種有效且勇於承擔風險的工程文化。」
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang became embroiled in an extramarital affair and violated the company’s code of conduct, and on Thursday (the 12th) he resigned in disgrace. Hours later, U.S. President Donald Trump posted that former Apple (AAPL-US) CEO Tim Cook should take over, sparking heated discussion.
After Huang’s resignation on Thursday, CFO Colette Kress has temporarily assumed the CEO duties, but NVIDIA has not yet confirmed a permanent successor.

Trump wrote on Truth Social on Thursday: “Since NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has resigned, and he was doing a great job, there is only one person to replace him – Apple’s Cook. One legend replacing another legend!”
Cook served as Apple’s CEO for 15 years until stepping down on September 1, when John Ternus succeeded him; Cook remains executive chairman of Apple’s board.

Trump backs Cook, but analysts say the odds of him taking the job are extremely low. In Cook’s final two years at Apple he built a close relationship with the Trump administration, especially after Apple pledged to invest hundreds of billions of dollars in the United States over the next four years, strengthening ties between the two sides.

Ed O’Gorman, CEO and managing partner of River Wealth Advisor, said: “During Cook’s tenure as Apple’s CEO, Trump developed a direct and pragmatic working relationship with him, so Trump may feel comfortable with that connection. He may also view Cook’s achievements after succeeding Steve Jobs as proof that he could handle the role.”

However, the likelihood of Cook becoming NVIDIA’s CEO is very low. O’Gorman added: “Although the news generated attention and the market briefly saw some trading activity, the actual probability of this happening is essentially zero.”

He noted that Apple and NVIDIA operate in fundamentally different businesses. Apple is the world’s largest consumer‑technology company, while NVIDIA makes chips that provide compute power for technology hardware. Cook’s expertise may not translate directly into the skills needed to run NVIDIA.

Joe Tigay, portfolio manager at Equity Armor Investments, echoed the view, saying: “Cook is a reassuring choice, a proven operational and diplomatic leader, and someone Trump knows how to deal with. But I think his chances of moving to NVIDIA are very low. We should treat this as a candidate Trump suggested, not as a fact, and not assume it reflects the wishes of NVIDIA’s board or Cook himself.”

Different business DNA and an overly cautious AI approach. Cook is seen as a successful corporate leader; under his tenure Apple’s stock surged roughly twenty‑fold. He launched impressive products such as AirPods and the Apple Watch and dramatically reshaped the company’s services business. Today Apple is known for a highly sticky ecosystem that keeps consumers repeatedly buying products and using services.
Barron’s argued that if Cook were to leave now to head a company in turmoil, it could damage the reputation he has built over many years.

Cook has also faced criticism for Apple’s AI strategy. Apple’s partnership with AI labs to push the Apple Intelligence update has so far delivered features that have not dazzled consumers. One of the tough challenges facing Ternus as the new CEO will be to prove that these AI updates are truly effective.
O’Gorman said: “Cook has been very cautious in applying AI at Apple, whereas NVIDIA has cultivated an effective, risk‑taking engineering culture.”

items.title_en: 26 Billion of Fresh Capital Boosts Liquidity of Lijing Investment Holding's Unlisted Shares
paras: 力晶創新投資控股公司(力晶投控)未上市股票流動性再添助力，除本公司實行庫藏股、山一投資公開購買股份，合計總額20億元股權外，鈺創、晶豪科等友好企業也先後宣布各以3億元向特定人洽購或直接在未上市的市場購買等方式，長期投資力晶投控股權。這一波總計26億元的購買股權行動，為未上市股票市場資金池注入可觀活水。
力晶投控透露，總額10億元的庫藏股公開收購計畫，已進入最後核算階段，預計將可在20日以每股42元將所有購股款項匯入合格交易股東的帳戶。山一投資的總額10億元、每股40-45元的公開購買也獲得力晶投控股東的熱烈響應，即將在16日截止。
有意售股的力晶投控股東，可趕在截止登記前至山一投資登記售股意願。據先前承辦單位公告，山ㄧ投資公司將於12月4日把股款匯入合格交易的股東帳戶。
據了解，力晶投控友好廠商鈺創、晶豪科相繼宣布總額各3億元的購買股票計畫，有別於力晶投控的庫藏股以及山一投資採公開購買方式，鈺創與晶豪科旗下的晶湛投資公司都將先洽有出售意願的特定人購買股份，其他餘額部分則會在未上市股票市場管道買入。
力晶投控表示，有正式提交出售意願書的股東，如果沒有趕上庫藏股或山一投資公開購買計畫，該公司也將在詢問相關股東意願後，轉介其他友好廠商評估，以利有意願出售的股東，也有機會依洽特定人的管道進行股份交易。
paras_en: Lijing Innovation Investment Holding Co. (Lijing Investment Holding) sees its unlisted stock liquidity further strengthened. In addition to the company’s own treasury‑share program and a public purchase by Shan‑yi Investment totaling NT$20 billion in equity, friendly firms such as Yuchuang and Jinghao Technology have each announced NT$3 billion purchases—either by negotiating with specific parties or buying directly in the unlisted market—to make long‑term investments in Lijing’s equity. This wave of NT$26 billion in share‑buying injects substantial fresh capital into the unlisted‑stock market pool.

Lijing Investment Holding disclosed that its NT$10 billion treasury‑share public acquisition plan has entered the final accounting stage and is expected to remit all purchase funds to eligible shareholders’ accounts at NT$42 per share on the 20th. Shan‑yi Investment’s NT$10 billion public purchase, priced at NT$40‑45 per share, has also received enthusiastic response from Lijing shareholders and will close on the 16th.

Shareholders wishing to sell their Lijing shares can register their intent with Shan‑yi Investment before the deadline. According to a prior announcement by the handling agency, Shan‑yi Investment will transfer the purchase proceeds to eligible shareholders’ accounts on December 4.

It was reported that friendly vendors Yuchuang and Jinghao Technology each announced NT$3 billion stock‑purchase plans. Unlike Lijing’s treasury‑share program and Shan‑yi’s public purchase, Yuchuang and Jinghao’s subsidiary Jingzan Investment will first negotiate purchases with specific sellers who have expressed intent, with any remaining amount to be bought through the unlisted‑stock market channel.

Lijing Investment Holding stated that shareholders who have formally submitted a sale intent but miss the treasury‑share or Shan‑yi public purchase programs will be referred, after consulting the relevant shareholders, to other friendly firms for evaluation, allowing willing sellers the opportunity to trade shares via the specific‑buyer channel.

items.title: Fed仍難鬆口氣！美國10月PPI月增低於預期 年增卻創近四年新高
items.title_en: Fed Still Can't Breathe Easy! US October PPI MoM Below Expectations, YoY Hits Near‑Four‑Year High
paras: 美國10月生產者物價指數(PPI)月增幅略低於預期，但年增率升至6.5%，創2022年11月以來最高，顯示通膨壓力仍難消退。食品、運輸與倉儲成本持續上漲，加上就業市場強勁，使市場維持聯準會(Fed)12月升息的預期，並關注是否可能一口氣升息2碼(50個基點)。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)周五(13日)公布，10月最終需求PPI月增0.3%，低於《路透》調查預估的0.4%；9月月增率則由1.3%上修至1.4%。年增率從9月的6.3%升至6.5%，反映短期漲勢雖放緩，整體價格壓力仍高。

食品與運輸成本續漲 核心通膨仍具黏性

排除食品與能源的核心PPI月增0.3%，符合預期，年增5%。進一步排除波動較大的貿易服務後，PPI月增0.5%、年增4.9%，顯示價格壓力並未侷限於能源與食品。
商品價格月增0.5%，主要受到食品與基本有機化學品帶動。其中，食品批發價格上漲1.3%，為2月以來最大月增幅，中東衝突、俄烏戰爭與關稅等因素持續推升成本。
運輸與倉儲成本繼9月上漲3.4%後，10月再漲2%；能源價格則在前月大漲後小幅回落0.1%，暫時減輕部分壓力，但不足以扭轉整體年增率攀升的趨勢。
服務價格月增0.2%，連續第五個月上升，但因貿易服務價格下跌，漲勢有所放緩。從企業角度來看，上游成本若持續增加，業者將面臨吸收成本、壓縮利潤，或向消費者轉嫁價格的壓力。

12月升息預期未退 市場仍防範一次升2碼

這份報告公布前，美國10月消費者物價漲幅高於預期，非農就業也強勁增加，失業率由4.2%降至4.1%。物價與就業數據共同顯示，Fed尚難對通膨鬆懈。
Fed理事華勒近期的談話，也讓市場在12月升息1碼的主要預期之外，保留升息2碼的可能性，相關機率仍約15%。芝商所FedWatch工具顯示，市場也預期明年1月可能再度升息。Fed上月將基準利率維持在3.75%至4%。
部分PPI細項會納入Fed偏好的個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)，因此後續通膨走勢仍受關注。10月航空票價、醫院門診及醫師照護價格上升，護理之家照護、法律服務與遊戲軟體發行價格則下降，呈現不一走勢。
美國經濟分析局預定11月25日公布10月PCE、個人所得與支出數據，將為Fed於12月9日作出利率決策提供更多依據。
paras_en: The US producer price index (PPI) for October rose slightly less than expected on a monthly basis, but the annual increase climbed to 6.5%, the highest since November 2022, indicating that inflationary pressure remains difficult to dispel. Food, transportation and warehousing costs kept rising, and a strong labour market kept the market expecting a Fed rate hike in December and watching whether a two‑step (50‑basis‑point) increase could happen in one go.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) released on Friday the 13th that the final demand PPI for October rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, below Reuters’ forecast of 0.4%; September’s monthly increase was revised up from 1.3% to 1.4%. The year‑over‑year rate rose from 6.3% in September to 6.5%, reflecting a short‑term slowdown in the surge but still high overall price pressure.

Food and transportation costs kept climbing, and core inflation remains sticky. Core PPI – excluding food and energy – rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, in line with expectations, and 5% year‑over‑year. Stripping out the more volatile trade services, PPI rose 0.5% month‑over‑month and 4.9% year‑over‑year, showing price pressure is not confined to energy and food.

Commodity prices rose 0.5% month‑over‑month, driven mainly by food and basic organic chemicals. Food wholesale prices jumped 1.3%, the biggest monthly gain since February, as Middle‑East conflicts, the Russia‑Ukraine war and tariffs continued to push costs higher.

Transportation and warehousing costs, after a 3.4% rise in September, increased another 2% in October; energy prices, after a sharp jump the month before, slipped 0.1%, temporarily easing some pressure but not enough to reverse the overall upward trend in the annual rate.

Service prices rose 0.2% month‑over‑month, marking the fifth consecutive month of increase, though the pace slowed as trade‑service prices fell. From a corporate perspective, if upstream costs keep rising, firms will face the dilemma of absorbing costs, squeezing margins, or passing the higher prices onto consumers.

The expectation of a December rate hike has not faded, and the market still guards against a two‑step increase. Before this report was released, US consumer price inflation for October came in higher than expected and non‑farm payrolls added strongly, with the unemployment rate falling from 4.2% to 4.1%. The combination of price and employment data shows the Fed still finds it hard to ease up on inflation.

Fed Governor Waller’s recent remarks have kept the market’s probability of a two‑step (50‑basis‑point) hike in December at about 15%, in addition to the main expectation of a one‑step move. The CME FedWatch tool also shows the market anticipating a possible rate hike again in January next year. The Fed left its policy rate unchanged last month at 3.75%‑4.00%.

Some PPI components feed into the Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, so the future path of inflation remains under close watch. In October, airline ticket prices, hospital outpatient and physician services rose, while nursing‑home care, legal services and video‑game publishing prices fell, showing a mixed picture.

The US Bureau of Economic Analysis is scheduled to release October PCE, personal income and spending data on November 25, which will give the Fed more information for its rate‑decision meeting on December 9.

items.title: 羅昇機器人大腦打入國際頂級品牌供應鏈 累計出貨破千套
items.title_en: Rosen's Robot Brain Enters International Top-Brand Supply Chains, Cumulative Shipments Exceed 1,000 Units
paras: 佳世達(2352-TW)旗下羅昇(8374-TW)今(13)日舉行法說，總經理李長堅表示，今年「機器人大腦」已打入國際頂級機器人品牌供應鏈，海外累計出貨突破數千套，展望2027年，將持續深耕半導體、機器人與智慧物流等關鍵領域，擴大高附加價值產品及系統整合比重，強化長期成長動能。
李長堅表示，先進機器人搭載的AI運算平台「機器人大腦」，須具備高算力、低延遲的環境感知與即時決策能力，才能支援複雜工廠及倉儲環境中的自主導航。羅昇從前期開發驗證、客戶規格適配，到量產備料與供應鏈調度，協助客戶縮短開發及量產導入時程，目前累計出貨已突破數千套。
除機器人大腦外，羅昇也持續投入機器人動力控制模組、感測模組及次系統核心技術研發，今年推出機器人關節模組，協助客戶克服從設計驗證到量產階段的技術及供應鏈挑戰，加速AI技術轉化為商用機器人產品。
半導體方面，羅昇持續整合運動控制、驅動、運算、感測、電源、節能系統及流體等關鍵技術，並與專精矽晶圓及玻璃載板再生清洗的華矽創新(USIC)深化合作，協助先進製程客戶降低成本與碳排放，擴大半導體供應鏈布局。
智慧物流方面，羅昇進一步整合怡進(TRANSPAK)的包裝設備技術，共同推進AI微型倉儲、自動化包裝及堆拆棧方案，並結合AI 3D機器視覺檢測與數據管理平台，加速智慧物流應用落地。
羅昇前三季營收達44.42億元，年增36.21%，創歷史同期新高，毛利率維持24.61%，每股純益1.39元，李長堅表示，羅昇正從產品供應商進一步朝技術整合與次系統方案發展，並透過佳世達集團「AI解決方案與智慧製造」的跨企業協作，複製成熟技術與場域經驗，提升高毛利產品及解決方案比重。
paras_en: Jasda (2352-TW) subsidiary Rosen (8374-TW) held a legal proceeding today (13th). General Manager Li Chang‑Jian said that this year the "robot brain" has entered the supply chain of top international robot brands, with overseas cumulative shipments surpassing several thousand units. Looking ahead to 2027, the company will continue to deepen its focus on semiconductors, robotics and smart logistics, expand the proportion of high‑value‑added products and system integration, and strengthen long‑term growth momentum.

Li explained that the AI computing platform "robot brain" mounted on advanced robots must provide high compute power, low latency, environmental perception and real‑time decision‑making to support autonomous navigation in complex factory and warehouse settings. Rosen assists customers from early development verification and specification matching to mass‑production material preparation and supply‑chain scheduling, helping shorten development and production rollout times; cumulative shipments have now exceeded several thousand units.

Beyond the robot brain, Rosen continues to invest in robot power‑control modules, sensor modules and core sub‑system technologies. This year it launched a robot joint module to help customers overcome technical and supply‑chain challenges from design verification to mass production, accelerating the conversion of AI technology into commercial robot products.

In the semiconductor arena, Rosen keeps integrating key technologies such as motion control, drive, computing, sensing, power, energy‑saving systems and fluid management, and deepens cooperation with USIC, a specialist in silicon wafer and glass substrate recycling cleaning. The partnership helps advanced‑process customers reduce costs and carbon emissions, expanding Rosen's footprint in the semiconductor supply chain.

In smart logistics, Rosen further integrates packaging equipment technology from Transpak (TRANSPAK), jointly advancing AI micro‑warehousing, automated packaging and palletizing solutions. It also combines AI 3D machine‑vision inspection with a data‑management platform to accelerate the deployment of smart‑logistics applications.

Rosen reported third‑quarter revenue of NT$4.442 billion, up 36.21% year over year, a historic high for the same period. Gross margin held at 24.61% and earnings per share were NT$1.39. Li said Rosen is moving from being a product supplier to developing technology integration and sub‑system solutions, leveraging Jasda Group's "AI Solutions and Smart Manufacturing" cross‑enterprise collaboration to replicate mature technologies and field experience, thereby increasing the share of high‑margin products and solutions.

items.title: 材料-KY布局購併進行中 1-9月每股賺進1.85元
items.title_en: Materials-KY’s M&A Strategy Ongoing, EPS 1.85 NT$ for Jan‑Sep
paras: 材料-KY(4763-TW)2026年下半年來營收已站穩10億元大關，公司今(13)日公布最新財報獲利資訊，材料-KY在2026年第三季營收回升到31.23億元，毛利率也回升到48%，季增7.11個百分點，但因自中國大陸匯出資金扣繳稅款達9.63億元影響，導致單季近損益兩平，2026年1-3季稅後純益18.29億元，每股純益1.85元。
展現跨區域、多元化發展的強大企圖心的材料-KY指出，對2026年第四季營收展望持審慎樂觀看法，將持續關注客戶庫存、終端需求與全球貿易環境，彈性調整營運步調，並依規劃推進Cerdia交易相關作業，深化全球布局與產品組合，提升長期競爭力。
材料-KY2026年第三季營收31.23億元，毛利率48%，季增7.11個百分點，年減12.33個百分點，本期淨利爲951萬元，歸屬母公司小虧204萬元，趨近於損益兩平。
材料-KY2026年1-9月營收86.78億元，毛利率48.04%，年減10.77個百分點，稅後純益18.29億元，年減62.56%，每股純益1.85元。
2026年第三季材料-KY營收為31.23億元，較去年同期成長27.6%，較前季成長9.8%。主要係下游客戶經過一年以上的庫存調整，整體產業庫存水位已逐步回歸正常區間，回補庫存需求帶動第三季營收成長。同時，第三季毛利率回升，主要係第二季受部分子公司擴大歲修範圍影響而推升單位成本。相關影響消退後，第三季合併毛利率由前季的40.9%回升至48.%，增加7.11個百分點。
2026年第三季材料-KY營業淨利為12.41億元，較前季成長27.8%。第三季營業費用率為8.2%，較前季6.7%增加1.5個百分點。費用上升主要係2026年第三季在「傳統出貨旺季、供應鏈繞道導致的運力吃緊、港口壅塞」等因素持續發酵下，整體海運費較第二季上漲，加上第三季透過海運外銷出口的占比提高，推升推銷費用。
2026年第三季材料-KY的本期淨利951萬元，較前季大幅減少，主要因進行併購需求，第三季中國大陸子公司盈餘匯出，依法扣繳相應稅款3,035萬美元，折合約新台幣9.63億元，這一次性稅務影響數，導致第三季稅後純益較第二季下滑，並不影響本業實質營運體質。公司將持續推動成本優化與營運韌性提升計畫，以掌握市場需求回補機會，穩固在醋酸纖維產業的領先地位及核心獲利能力。
材料-KY對第四季營收展望持審慎樂觀看法，將持續關注客戶庫存、終端需求與全球貿易環境，彈性調整營運步調，並依規劃推進Cerdia交易相關作業，深化全球布局與產品組合，提升長期競爭力。
材料-KY在2026年10月營收爲10.52億元，爲今年單月次高，月增2.69%，年增33.07%，1-10月營收97.29億元，年減13.53%。

材料-KY在全球布局方面，材料-KY已於2026年9月21日宣布，董事會通過與黑石集團（Blackstone）旗下管理基金簽署股份購買協議及股份交換契約，擬以現金及股票對價取得Cerdia Holding 100%股權。Cerdia擁有逾百年纖維素材料製造經驗，全球員工約1,100人，並於歐洲及美洲設有生產基地。待交易完成後，濟南大自然新材料營運據點將由中國延伸至德國、美國、巴西及俄羅斯，涵蓋亞洲、歐洲、北美洲與南美洲。公司預期，結合雙方生產據點、客戶基礎與研發能力，將有助提升生產調度、原料配置及客戶服務彈性，強化因應關稅、物流及地緣政治變化的能力。
paras_en: Materials‑KY (4763‑TW) has already secured revenue above NT$10 billion in the second half of 2026. The company announced its latest financial results today (13th). In Q3 2026, Materials‑KY’s revenue rose to NT$31.23 billion and its gross margin recovered to 48%, up 7.11 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter. However, a withholding tax of NT$9.63 billion on profit remitted from its mainland China subsidiary offset the gain, leaving the quarter essentially break‑even. For the first three quarters of 2026, after‑tax net profit was NT$18.29 billion, or NT$1.85 per share.

Materials‑KY, which demonstrates strong ambition for cross‑regional and diversified growth, said it holds a cautiously optimistic outlook for Q4 2026 revenue. It will continue to monitor customer inventories, end‑user demand and the global trade environment, flexibly adjust its operating pace, and proceed with the planned Cerdia transaction to deepen its global footprint and product portfolio, enhancing long‑term competitiveness.

In Q3 2026, Materials‑KY posted revenue of NT$31.23 billion, a gross margin of 48%, a quarter‑over‑quarter increase of 7.11 percentage points and a year‑over‑year decline of 12.33 percentage points. Net profit for the period was NT$9.51 million, with a small loss attributable to the parent of NT$2.04 million, essentially breakeven.

For the January‑September 2026 period, Materials‑KY recorded revenue of NT$86.78 billion, a gross margin of 48.04% (down 10.77 percentage points year‑over‑year), after‑tax net profit of NT$18.29 billion (down 62.56% year‑over‑year), and earnings of NT$1.85 per share.

Q3 2026 revenue of NT$31.23 billion grew 27.6% from the same quarter last year and 9.8% from the prior quarter. The growth was driven by downstream customers completing inventory adjustments of over a year, bringing industry inventory levels back toward normal and prompting restocking demand. The margin rebound was mainly because Q2 had higher unit costs due to an expanded scope of repairs by some subsidiaries; once that effect faded, the consolidated gross margin rose from 40.9% in Q2 to 48%, a gain of 7.11 percentage points.

Operating profit for Q3 2026 was NT$12.41 billion, up 27.8% from the prior quarter. The operating expense ratio rose to 8.2% from 6.7% a quarter earlier, a 1.5‑point increase. The expense rise stemmed from continued pressure in the traditional peak shipping season, tighter shipping capacity due to supply‑chain detours and port congestion, which lifted ocean freight rates versus Q2, together with a higher share of ocean‑freight exports in Q3, driving up selling expenses.

Net profit for the quarter was NT$9.51 million, a sharp decline from the prior quarter, mainly because of acquisition‑related activities. The mainland China subsidiary’s earnings were remitted abroad, and a statutory withholding tax of US$30.35 million (approximately NT$9.63 billion) was deducted. This one‑off tax impact reduced Q3 after‑tax profit versus Q2 but did not affect the core operating health. The company will continue cost‑optimization and operational‑resilience initiatives to capture inventory‑replenishment opportunities, solidifying its leading position and core profitability in the acetate fiber industry.

Materials‑KY maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook for Q4 revenue, will keep monitoring customer inventories, end‑user demand and the global trade environment, flexibly adjust its operating pace, and advance the planned Cerdia transaction to deepen its global footprint and product mix, thereby enhancing long‑term competitiveness.

In October 2026, Materials‑KY generated NT$10.52 billion in revenue, the second‑highest monthly figure of the year, up 2.69% month‑over‑month and 33.07% year‑over‑year. For the January‑October period, revenue totaled NT$97.29 billion, down 13.53% year‑over‑year.

Regarding its global expansion, Materials‑KY announced on 21 September 2026 that its board approved a share‑purchase agreement and share‑exchange contract with a Blackstone‑managed fund to acquire 100% of Cerdia Holding for cash and stock. Cerdia brings over a century of cellulose material manufacturing experience, about 1,100 employees worldwide, and production sites in Europe and the Americas. Upon completion, the Jinan Natural New Materials operation will extend from China into Germany, the United States, Brazil and Russia, covering Asia, Europe, North America and South America. The company expects that combining the two firms’ production sites, customer bases and R&D capabilities will improve production scheduling, raw‑material allocation and customer‑service flexibility, strengthening its ability to cope with tariffs, logistics and geopolitical shifts.

items.title_en: Juheng Flash – FactSet latest survey: EVA Air (2618‑TW) target price raised to 50 TWD, about a 4.17% increase
paras: 根據FactSet最新調查，共5位分析師，對長榮航(2618-TW)提出目標價估值：中位數由48元上修至50元，調升幅度4.17%。其中最高估值50元，最低估值47.5元。
綜合評級 - 共有5位分析師給予長榮航(2618-TW)評價：積極樂觀4位、保持中立2位、保守悲觀0位。
長榮航(2618-TW)今(13日)收盤價為47.75元。近5日股價上漲9.52%，相關航 運 業近5日上漲5.15%，集中市場加權指數上漲10.01%，股價波動與大盤表現同步。
資料來源：Factset，數據僅供參考，不作為投資建議。
paras_en: According to FactSet’s latest survey, five analysts provided target price estimates for EVA Air (2618‑TW): the median was revised up from 48 TWD to 50 TWD, an increase of 4.17%. The highest estimate is 50 TWD and the lowest is 47.5 TWD.
Overall ratings – a total of five analysts rated EVA Air (2618‑TW): 4 were bullish, 2 were neutral, and 0 were bearish.

EVA Air (2618‑TW) closed today (the 13th) at 47.75 TWD. Over the past five days the stock rose 9.52%, the related airline sector rose 5.15%, and the Taiwan Capitalization Weighted Index rose 10.01%, indicating that the stock’s movement was in line with the broader market.
Source: FactSet. Data are for reference only and do not constitute investment advice.

items.title: 26億資金活水注入  力晶投控未上市股流動性勁揚
items.title_en: 26 Billion of Fresh Capital Boosts Liquidity of Lijing Investment Holding's Unlisted Shares
paras: 力晶創新投資控股公司(力晶投控)未上市股票流動性再添助力，除本公司實行庫藏股、山一投資公開購買股份，合計總額20億元股權外，鈺創、晶豪科等友好企業也先後宣布各以3億元向特定人洽購或直接在未上市的市場購買等方式，長期投資力晶投控股權。這一波總計26億元的購買股權行動，為未上市股票市場資金池注入可觀活水。
力晶投控透露，總額10億元的庫藏股公開收購計畫，已進入最後核算階段，預計將可在20日以每股42元將所有購股款項匯入合格交易股東的帳戶。山一投資的總額10億元、每股40-45元的公開購買也獲得力晶投控股東的熱烈響應，即將在16日截止。
有意售股的力晶投控股東，可趕在截止登記前至山一投資登記售股意願。據先前承辦單位公告，山ㄧ投資公司將於12月4日把股款匯入合格交易的股東帳戶。
據了解，力晶投控友好廠商鈺創、晶豪科相繼宣布總額各3億元的購買股票計畫，有別於力晶投控的庫藏股以及山一投資採公開購買方式，鈺創與晶豪科旗下的晶湛投資公司都將先洽有出售意願的特定人購買股份，其他餘額部分則會在未上市股票市場管道買入。
力晶投控表示，有正式提交出售意願書的股東，如果沒有趕上庫藏股或山一投資公開購買計畫，該公司也將在詢問相關股東意願後，轉介其他友好廠商評估，以利有意願出售的股東，也有機會依洽特定人的管道進行股份交易。
paras_en: Lijing Innovation Investment Holding Co. (Lijing Investment Holding) sees its unlisted stock liquidity further strengthened. In addition to the company’s own treasury‑share program and a public purchase by Shan‑yi Investment totaling NT$20 billion in equity, friendly firms such as Yuchuang and Jinghao Technology have each announced NT$3 billion purchases—either by negotiating with specific parties or buying directly in the unlisted market—to make long‑term investments in Lijing’s equity. This wave of NT$26 billion in share‑buying injects substantial fresh capital into the unlisted‑stock market pool.

Lijing Investment Holding disclosed that its NT$10 billion treasury‑share public acquisition plan has entered the final accounting stage and is expected to remit all purchase funds to eligible shareholders’ accounts at NT$42 per share on the 20th. Shan‑yi Investment’s NT$10 billion public purchase, priced at NT$40‑45 per share, has also received enthusiastic response from Lijing shareholders and will close on the 16th.

Shareholders wishing to sell their Lijing shares can register their intent with Shan‑yi Investment before the deadline. According to a prior announcement by the handling agency, Shan‑yi Investment will transfer the purchase proceeds to eligible shareholders’ accounts on December 4.

It was reported that friendly vendors Yuchuang and Jinghao Technology each announced NT$3 billion stock‑purchase plans. Unlike Lijing’s treasury‑share program and Shan‑yi’s public purchase, Yuchuang and Jinghao’s subsidiary Jingzan Investment will first negotiate purchases with specific sellers who have expressed intent, with any remaining amount to be bought through the unlisted‑stock market channel.

Lijing Investment Holding stated that shareholders who have formally submitted a sale intent but miss the treasury‑share or Shan‑yi public purchase programs will be referred, after consulting the relevant shareholders, to other friendly firms for evaluation, allowing willing sellers the opportunity to trade shares via the specific‑buyer channel.

items.title: 羅昇機器人大腦打入國際頂級品牌供應鏈 累計出貨破千套
items.title_en: Rosen's Robot Brain Enters International Top-Brand Supply Chains, Cumulative Shipments Exceed 1,000 Units
paras: 佳世達(2352-TW)旗下羅昇(8374-TW)今(13)日舉行法說，總經理李長堅表示，今年「機器人大腦」已打入國際頂級機器人品牌供應鏈，海外累計出貨突破數千套，展望2027年，將持續深耕半導體、機器人與智慧物流等關鍵領域，擴大高附加價值產品及系統整合比重，強化長期成長動能。
李長堅表示，先進機器人搭載的AI運算平台「機器人大腦」，須具備高算力、低延遲的環境感知與即時決策能力，才能支援複雜工廠及倉儲環境中的自主導航。羅昇從前期開發驗證、客戶規格適配，到量產備料與供應鏈調度，協助客戶縮短開發及量產導入時程，目前累計出貨已突破數千套。
除機器人大腦外，羅昇也持續投入機器人動力控制模組、感測模組及次系統核心技術研發，今年推出機器人關節模組，協助客戶克服從設計驗證到量產階段的技術及供應鏈挑戰，加速AI技術轉化為商用機器人產品。
半導體方面，羅昇持續整合運動控制、驅動、運算、感測、電源、節能系統及流體等關鍵技術，並與專精矽晶圓及玻璃載板再生清洗的華矽創新(USIC)深化合作，協助先進製程客戶降低成本與碳排放，擴大半導體供應鏈布局。
智慧物流方面，羅昇進一步整合怡進(TRANSPAK)的包裝設備技術，共同推進AI微型倉儲、自動化包裝及堆拆棧方案，並結合AI 3D機器視覺檢測與數據管理平台，加速智慧物流應用落地。
羅昇前三季營收達44.42億元，年增36.21%，創歷史同期新高，毛利率維持24.61%，每股純益1.39元，李長堅表示，羅昇正從產品供應商進一步朝技術整合與次系統方案發展，並透過佳世達集團「AI解決方案與智慧製造」的跨企業協作，複製成熟技術與場域經驗，提升高毛利產品及解決方案比重。
paras_en: Jasda (2352-TW) subsidiary Rosen (8374-TW) held a legal proceeding today (13th). General Manager Li Chang‑Jian said that this year the "robot brain" has entered the supply chain of top international robot brands, with overseas cumulative shipments surpassing several thousand units. Looking ahead to 2027, the company will continue to deepen its focus on semiconductors, robotics and smart logistics, expand the proportion of high‑value‑added products and system integration, and strengthen long‑term growth momentum.

Li explained that the AI computing platform "robot brain" mounted on advanced robots must provide high compute power, low latency, environmental perception and real‑time decision‑making to support autonomous navigation in complex factory and warehouse settings. Rosen assists customers from early development verification and specification matching to mass‑production material preparation and supply‑chain scheduling, helping shorten development and production rollout times; cumulative shipments have now exceeded several thousand units.

Beyond the robot brain, Rosen continues to invest in robot power‑control modules, sensor modules and core sub‑system technologies. This year it launched a robot joint module to help customers overcome technical and supply‑chain challenges from design verification to mass production, accelerating the conversion of AI technology into commercial robot products.

In the semiconductor arena, Rosen keeps integrating key technologies such as motion control, drive, computing, sensing, power, energy‑saving systems and fluid management, and deepens cooperation with USIC, a specialist in silicon wafer and glass substrate recycling cleaning. The partnership helps advanced‑process customers reduce costs and carbon emissions, expanding Rosen's footprint in the semiconductor supply chain.

In smart logistics, Rosen further integrates packaging equipment technology from Transpak (TRANSPAK), jointly advancing AI micro‑warehousing, automated packaging and palletizing solutions. It also combines AI 3D machine‑vision inspection with a data‑management platform to accelerate the deployment of smart‑logistics applications.

Rosen reported third‑quarter revenue of NT$4.442 billion, up 36.21% year over year, a historic high for the same period. Gross margin held at 24.61% and earnings per share were NT$1.39. Li said Rosen is moving from being a product supplier to developing technology integration and sub‑system solutions, leveraging Jasda Group's "AI Solutions and Smart Manufacturing" cross‑enterprise collaboration to replicate mature technologies and field experience, thereby increasing the share of high‑margin products and solutions.

items.title: 信立Q3受惠本業+業外挹注 獲利季增近3倍爆量成長
items.title_en: Xinli Q3 Benefits from Core Business and Non‑Operating Gains, Profit Surges Nearly 3‑Fold with Massive Growth
paras: 信立化學(4303-TW)受惠本業營運動能持續提升，加上業外認列轉投資金融評價利益挹注，第3季稅後純益為9,487萬元、季增3.66倍，稅後盈餘(EPS)達0.72元也較上季成長，累計今(2026)年前3季合併營收達9.17億元，稅後純益7,010萬元，EPS達0.53元。
信立表示，第3季營運表現亮眼，受惠持續拓展鞋材、包材、運動用品及機能材料等多元應用市場，高附加價值合成皮革、機能性膜材與特殊效果材料出貨增加，帶動整體產品組合持續優化；
另信立推動營運轉型，深化母公司永捷(4714-TW)、子公司普大應用材料及邁達康(9960-TW)之間的策略聯盟，透過垂直與水平資源整合，從上游PU樹脂配方、機能膜材研發、合成皮革貼合加工，到終端運動用品及多元應用市場，逐步擴大集團整體業務綜效，包括第3季毛利率達25％，季增4個百分點，營業利益率達4％，在高附加價值產品出貨成長及營運效率持續改善下，帶動本業獲利能力。
信立10月營收達1.37億元、年增96.66％，續創歷年同期新高，累計今年1至10月合併營收達10.54億元、年增23.97％，亦刷新歷年同期記錄。
信立10月營收成長，受惠國際運動品牌持續推進新品上市、復刻鞋款及節慶檔期備貨需求，高附加價值合成皮革、機能性膜材與特殊效果材料出貨維持良好動能，加上子公司邁達康旗下電商通路客戶拉貨而同步回升，亦為10月營收增添成長動能，帶動信立整體業務表現持續向上。
展望未來今年第4季，信立持審慎樂觀看法。隨著國際運動品牌持續推進秋冬新品、節慶檔期及下一年度鞋款開發，有助延續高附加價值合成皮革、輕量化PU Film與特殊效果材料的市場需求，信立也將持續深化永捷、普大應材及邁達康之間的策略聯盟，結合上游材料研發、中游加工製程與下游品牌及通路資源，加速新材料開發驗證與市場應用。
paras_en: Xinli Chemical (4303‑TW) benefited from continued momentum in its core operations and from non‑operating gains from the valuation of its financial investments, posting a Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$94.87 million – a 3.66‑times increase quarter‑over‑quarter – with an EPS of NT$0.72, also up from the prior quarter. For the first three quarters of 2026, consolidated revenue reached NT$9.17 billion, after‑tax net profit was NT$70.10 million and EPS was NT$0.53.

Xinli said its Q3 operating performance was strong, driven by ongoing expansion into diverse application markets such as footwear materials, packaging, sports goods and functional materials. Shipments of high‑value synthetic leather, functional films and special‑effect materials rose, further optimizing the overall product mix.

The company is also advancing an operational transformation, deepening the strategic alliance among parent Yongjie (4714‑TW), subsidiary Puda Applied Materials and MidaKang (9960‑TW). By integrating vertical and horizontal resources—from upstream PU resin formulations and functional film R&D, to synthetic‑leather lamination and downstream sports‑goods and other applications—the group is gradually expanding overall business synergies. In Q3, gross margin reached 25 %, up four percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter, and operating margin hit 4 %, reflecting growth in high‑value product shipments and continued efficiency improvements that boost core profitability.

Xinli’s October revenue hit NT$1.37 billion, up 96.66 % year‑over‑year, setting a new record for the same month in company history. Cumulative revenue for January‑October 2026 reached NT$10.54 billion, a 23.97 % year‑over‑year increase, also a historic high for the period.

The October revenue growth was driven by international sports brands continuing to launch new products, re‑release sneaker lines and stock up for holiday seasons, keeping shipments of high‑value synthetic leather, functional films and special‑effect materials robust. In addition, MidaKang’s e‑commerce channel customers placed larger orders, further adding momentum to October sales and lifting Xinli’s overall business performance.

Looking ahead to Q4 2026, Xinli maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook. Ongoing releases of autumn‑winter collections, holiday campaigns and next‑year shoe development by international sports brands are expected to sustain demand for high‑value synthetic leather, lightweight PU film and special‑effect materials. Xinli will continue to deepen the strategic alliance among Yongjie, Puda Applied Materials and MidaKang, combining upstream material R&D, mid‑stream processing and downstream brand and channel resources to accelerate new material development, validation and market adoption.

items.title: 永捷麻豆廠明年Q3起生產環保材料訂單 Q3獲利虧轉盈
items.title_en: Yongjie’s Madou Plant to Start Producing Eco‑Friendly Materials Orders in Q3 Next Year, Q3 Profit Turns from Loss to Gain
paras: 永捷(4714-TW)第3季稅後純益1,557萬元，EPS為0.07元，較上季轉虧為盈，累計今(2026)年前3季合稅後淨損217萬元，每股稅後淨損-0.01元。永捷表示，第3季受惠國際運動品牌新品上市及備貨需求增溫，帶動高機能、環保型鞋材訂單出貨增加，也帶動單季毛利率提升至26％水準。
永捷第3季合併營收達5.4億元，季減4％、年增40％，創歷年同期新高；單季稅後純益1,557萬元、EPS為0.07元。永捷甫公告10月營收達1.72億元、年增72.12％，續創歷年同期新高，累計今年前10月合併營收達18.96億元、年增63.54％，也刷新歷年同期新高。
永捷指出，受惠國際運動品牌持續推進新品開發與年終銷售備貨，高機能鞋材、環保型PU樹脂及特殊材料出貨需求維持良好，加上集團材料垂直整合效益逐步發揮，進一步擴大整體營收規模，也展現多元業務布局成果。

永捷表示，看好全球品牌供應鏈對環保永續材料的重視程度持續提升，尤其歐盟針對PFHxA及相關物質的限制規範逐步實施，促使鞋類及相關材料供應鏈加速尋求符合環保法規的替代方案，帶動無氟塗層、低溶劑及可追溯材料的開發需求，公司持續推進水性PU、高固含量、無溶劑產品及無氟抗刮耐磨助劑等技術開發，積極掌握國際品牌對材料性能、環保規範及供應鏈管理的多重要求，並透過高附加價值產品組合優化，強化全球環保永續材料市場競爭優勢。
此外，為因應海外環保材料訂單需求，永捷積極推進麻豆廠公共危險物品倉庫建置，提升化學原物料安全備貨及供應調度能力，持續進行反應槽擴建工程，規劃於明(2027)年第3季投入生產，以擴充聚酯多元醇產能，支應歐洲、日本及印度等海外市場業務拓展。
展望第4季，永捷持審慎樂觀看法，將持續深化綠色環保材料、高機能鞋材業務，亦積極布局新世代電子材料，投入可撓式硬塗層(Hard Coat，HC)技術開發，掌握折疊式顯示裝置對輕薄、耐磨及高可靠度材料的需求，拓展高附加價值應用商機，同步完善集團垂直水平資源整合綜效，以期帶動未來營運良好成長動能。
paras_en: Yongjie (4714‑TW) reported a Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$15.57 million, EPS NT$0.07, turning from a loss in the prior quarter to a profit, while the cumulative after‑tax net loss for the first three quarters of 2026 stands at NT$2.17 million, or a loss per share of NT‑0.01. The company said Q3 benefited from new product launches by international sports brands and warming inventory demand, which boosted shipments of high‑performance, environmentally‑friendly shoe materials and lifted the quarterly gross margin to about 26 %.

Yongjie’s Q3 consolidated revenue reached NT$540 million, down 4 % quarter‑on‑quarter but up 40 % year‑on‑year, a historic high for the same period. Quarterly after‑tax profit was NT$15.57 million, EPS NT$0.07. The company also announced October revenue of NT$172 million, up 72.12 % YoY, again a record high, and cumulative revenue for the first ten months of the year hit NT$1.896 billion, up 63.54 % YoY, also a historic peak.

Yongjie noted that continued new‑product development and year‑end stock‑piling by international sports brands kept demand strong for high‑performance shoe materials, eco‑friendly PU resin and special materials. Coupled with the gradual payoff of the group’s vertical material integration, overall revenue scale is expanding further, showcasing the results of its diversified business strategy.

Yongjie said it is confident that global brand supply chains are placing increasing emphasis on sustainable materials, especially as the EU’s phased‑in restrictions on PFHxA and related substances push the footwear and related material supply chain to seek compliant alternatives. This fuels demand for fluorine‑free coatings, low‑solvent and traceable materials. The company continues to develop water‑based PU, high‑solid‑content, solvent‑free products and fluorine‑free anti‑scratch, wear‑resistant additives, actively meeting international brands’ multiple requirements on material performance, environmental regulations and supply‑chain management, and by optimizing a high‑value‑added product mix, strengthens its competitive edge in the global sustainable‑materials market.

To meet overseas eco‑material order demand, Yongjie is actively advancing the construction of a public hazardous‑materials warehouse at its Madou plant to improve safety stocking and supply logistics of chemical raw materials, and continues expanding its reaction‑vessel capacity. The plant is slated to begin production in Q3 2027, expanding polyester polyol capacity to support business growth in Europe, Japan and India.

Looking ahead to Q4, Yongjie maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook, will keep deepening its green eco‑material and high‑performance shoe‑material businesses, and is actively positioning itself in next‑generation electronic materials by investing in flexible hard‑coat (HC) technology to meet foldable‑display needs for lightweight, wear‑resistant and highly reliable materials, expanding high‑value‑added application opportunities while perfecting the group’s vertical and horizontal resource‑integration synergies to drive future growth momentum.

items.title: 黃仁勳走了還沒完！美財長開砲商務部 輝達也得說清楚
items.title_en: Nvidia’s Turmoil Continues After Jensen Huang’s Exit: Treasury Secretary Slams Commerce Dept, Nvidia Must Clarify
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)風波進一步延燒至川普政府內部。據《金融時報》與《彭博》報導，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)公開表示，財政部等多個部門數月來一直支持將Megaspeed列入貿易黑名單，但決策權掌握在商務部手中。他也要求追究輝達相關人員的責任，質疑公司是否充分查核客戶並防止晶片流入中國。
這番發言讓商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)承受更大壓力。Megaspeed涉嫌將輝達晶片走私至中國的調查已持續一年多，而黃仁勳因涉及與美方懷疑具有中國情報背景的黃樂(Alice Huang)發生婚外情而辭任，使晶片出口審查與企業內控問題成為華府焦點。

多部門早支持列入黑名單 貝森特將矛頭指向商務部

貝森特接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，財政部、美國貿易代表署及國務院，數月來都贊成將Megaspeed列入實體清單，但「主導權在商務部」，外界應向商務部詢問內部處理程序。
《金融時報》本周稍早報導，商務部曾延後將Megaspeed列入黑名單的相關作業。實體清單是美國出口管制工具之一，美國企業若要向名單內公司出口受管制產品，須取得商務部許可，以防先進技術落入中國軍方手中。
對於是否曾就此事與盧特尼克當面交鋒，貝森特未正面回應，僅表示：「我們不會重述戰情室內的對話。」
貝森特說，川普已明確表示，中國不應取得比H100更先進的輝達晶片，因此任何外流都令人沮喪，既傷害美國企業，也可能讓中國在AI競賽中取得優勢。
被問及是否需要改變晶片出口政策時，他強調，政府已具備所需權限，重點是落實執行，暗示問題並非缺乏管制工具，而是現有措施是否確實執行。

國會施壓盧特尼克 輝達客戶審查也遭追問

國會對商務部的壓力同步升高。共和黨議員要求盧特尼克赴國會作證，民主黨高層則要求他保存相關文件，以供後續調查。據《彭博》報導，盧特尼克已同意作證。
參議院銀行委員會民主黨首席議員華倫要求，盧特尼克必須說明為何尚未堵住出口管制漏洞，並立即採取行動，確保美國先進技術不會助長中國軍力。不過，川普目前仍公開支持盧特尼克，在輝達宣布黃仁勳辭職後表達對他的信任。
貝森特也將問責焦點指向輝達，質疑公司是否真正了解客戶，以及是否採取充分措施，確保晶片沒有外流、買家並非僅供轉手交易的空殼公司。他表示，公司內應對相關問題負責的人，都必須受到追究。
此外，貝森特點名曾介入美國政府調查Megaspeed涉嫌走私AI晶片案的輝達法務長Tim Teter，批評他應加強監督，而非一味責難調查。他並預期，輝達董事會將對事件展開徹底調查。
上述發言進一步擴大問責範圍，但貝森特對客戶審查與晶片外流的質疑，並不等同於已認定輝達或相關人員違法。
paras_en: The Nvidia (NVDA-US) controversy has further spread within the Trump administration. According to the Financial Times and Bloomberg, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly said that the Treasury and several other agencies have been supporting the inclusion of Megaspeed on the trade blacklist for months, but the decision authority rests with the Commerce Department. He also called for holding Nvidia personnel accountable, questioning whether the company has adequately vetted customers and prevented chips from flowing to China.

The remarks put Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick under greater pressure. The investigation into Megaspeed’s alleged smuggling of Nvidia chips to China has been ongoing for more than a year, and Jensen Huang’s resignation amid allegations of an affair with Alice Huang, who is suspected of having Chinese intelligence ties, has made chip export reviews and corporate internal controls a focus in Washington.

Multiple agencies had early support for blacklisting Megaspeed; Bessent points the finger at Commerce. In an interview with CNBC, Bessent said the Treasury, the U.S. Trade Representative’s office and the State Department have for months agreed to place Megaspeed on the Entity List, but “the lead authority is the Commerce Department,” and outsiders should ask Commerce about its internal procedures.

The Financial Times reported earlier this week that Commerce had delayed actions to add Megaspeed to the blacklist. The Entity List is one of the U.S. export‑control tools; U.S. firms must obtain a Commerce Department license to export controlled products to listed companies, to prevent advanced technology from reaching the Chinese military.
When asked whether he had confronted Lutnick directly about the matter, Bessent gave no direct answer, saying only, “We will not repeat the dialogue that took place in the war room.”

Bessent said Trump has made it clear that China should not obtain Nvidia chips more advanced than the H100, so any leakage is disappointing, harming U.S. companies and potentially giving China an edge in the AI race.

When questioned about whether chip‑export policy needs to change, he emphasized that the government already has the necessary authority; the issue is implementation, implying the problem is not a lack of tools but whether existing measures are being enforced.

Congress ramps up pressure on Lutnick; Nvidia’s customer vetting also comes under scrutiny. Republican lawmakers are demanding Lutnick testify before Congress, while senior Democrats want him to preserve relevant documents for further investigation. Bloomberg reports that Lutnick has agreed to testify.

Senate Banking Committee Democratic Chair Warren has asked Lutnick to explain why export‑control gaps have not been closed and to act immediately to ensure U.S. advanced technology does not bolster Chinese military power. However, Trump continues to publicly back Lutnick, expressing confidence in him after Nvidia announced Huang’s resignation.

Bessent also shifted accountability onto Nvidia, questioning whether the company truly understands its customers and has taken sufficient steps to ensure chips do not leak and that buyers are not merely shell companies for resale. He said anyone at Nvidia responsible for these issues must be held accountable.

He further singled out Nvidia’s chief legal officer Tim Teter, who had been involved in the government’s investigation of Megaspeed’s alleged AI‑chip smuggling, criticizing him for needing to strengthen oversight rather than merely blaming the probe, and he expects Nvidia’s board to conduct a thorough investigation.
These comments broaden the scope of accountability, but Bessent’s doubts about customer vetting and chip leakage do not equate to a legal finding that Nvidia or its personnel have violated the law.

items.title: 黃仁勳突卸輝達執行長震撼矽谷 Twitter前CEO預測他3年後王者歸來
paras: 人工智慧(AI)革命的核心領航者、掌舵輝達(Nvidia)長達33年的創辦人兼執行長黃仁勳，周四(12日)正式辭去執行長職務。這起震撼矽谷與全球資本市場的重大人事變動，不僅終結了科技史上最具代表性的創辦人治理時代之一，更引發了關於「創辦人不可替代性」、公司治理界線、併購案變數以及輝達未來估值的激烈辯論。

33年創辦人帝國的驟然更迭

自 1993 年在矽谷一家平價餐廳與夥伴共同創立輝達以來，黃仁勳一直是這家晶片巨擘唯一的執行長。在他33年的領導下，輝達從一家專注於 3D 繪圖晶片的初創企業，一步步轉型為支撐全球 AI 算力基礎設施的市值龍頭。然而，根據知情人士透露，輝達董事會在收到包含涉及與涉嫌為中國從事情報活動的女性以及公司內部員工的兩起緋聞舉報後，決定解除黃仁勳的職務。
董事會隨後指派輝達長期擔任財務長的科萊特·克雷斯(Colette Kress)接任代理執行長，以期在風暴中穩住經營大局。
黃仁勳的離去消息一出，科技界、華爾街與政治圈無不震驚，紛紛聚焦於這究竟是輝達董事會的合規自救，還是一場無法挽回的歷史性戰略失誤。

矽谷創投與科技圈巨頭的集體陣痛與分歧

黃仁勳在科技界的影響力早已超越單一企業執行長，更被視為全球 AI 產業的非官方大使。因此，其下台在矽谷創投界與創業家群體中引發了極大的陣痛與強烈反彈。
許多知名投資人與企業家將此事件視為破壞科技創新生態的嚴重錯誤：
Martin Casado(Andreessen Horowitz 一般合夥人)：在社交平台 X 上直言這是「極其黑暗的一天」，並形容為「對美國與西方世界極其糟糕的決定」。他更公開表示，若黃仁勳願意加入 Andreessen Horowitz，將是無上的榮幸。
Tobi Lütke(Shopify 創辦人兼執行長)：警告此舉是「世代級的重大失誤」(generational blunder)，並指出輝達未來極可能淪為黃仁勳所創造之偉大公司的拙劣模仿者，強調：「沒有人能夠替代像黃仁勳這樣的創辦人。」
Naval Ravikant(知名風險投資人)：引用蘋果解僱賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)與 Uber 逼走卡蘭尼克(Travis Kalanick)的歷史先例，反問產業界是否仍未汲取「創辦人無法被輕易替換」的歷史教訓。對此，SpaceX 與特斯拉執行長 Elon Musk 亦在下方簡短回應「所言甚是」(True words)，並轉載電影《AIR》經典台詞向黃仁勳致敬。
Stephen Witt(黃仁勳傳記作者)：在接受 CNBC 專訪時指出，黃仁勳即代表了輝達本身，就如同芝加哥公牛隊失去了麥可·喬丹(Michael Jordan)。他特別提到，黃仁勳能夠單憑記憶徒手畫出輝達設備中每一個零件的爆炸圖，這種對技術與產品細節的掌控力在業界根本找不到替代者。
Raj Gokal(Solana Labs 共同創辦人)：將董事會的決定評為「世代級的失誤」(generational fumble)。
Alex Bouaziz(Deel 執行長)：直接判定輝達董事會的決策是一個「錯誤」。
Cristóbal Valenzuela(Runway AI 共同創辦人)與 Sarah Guo(Conviction 創辦人)：一致認為黃仁勳的離去對整個 AI 產業是「巨大的損失」。

業界情感致敬與聲援

除批評董事會決策外，多位科技領袖亦表達了對黃仁勳三十三年貢獻的敬意。Perplexity AI 創辦人 Aravind Srinivas 感謝黃仁勳勇敢領導輝達躍升為美國最有價值的企業，並為無數 AI 創業家奠定基礎；幣安創辦人 趙長鵬(CZ) 坦言輝達放走黃仁勳絕對是錯誤；Epic Games 創辦人 Tim Sweeney 表示這是輝達、開發者與全人類的悲哀之日。
知名播客主持人 Lex Fridman 則發長文指出，在接觸過數百名工程師與 CEO 後，未曾聽聞有人對黃仁勳有過負面評價，堅定表示「我站在黃仁勳這邊」。前高盛執行長 Lloyd Blankfein 則引述戴高樂的名言感歎這是一場莎士比亞式的悲劇，但也提醒「墓地裡躺滿了不可或缺的人」。

併購案生變與前沿技術生態系的連帶衝擊

黃仁勳突遭解職，迅速對輝達正處於推進階段的重大戰略佈局與前沿技術投資產生連帶連鎖反應。
其中最受矚目的，是輝達原計畫以 130 億美元(或 129 億美元)收購知名開源 AI 平台 Hugging Face 的交易。Hugging Face 執行長 Clement Delangue 在社交媒體上坦言：「整件事非常糟糕，我希望這一切從未發生。」
但他隨即強調，無論高層如何變動，Hugging Face 都將比以往更加努力地為開源 AI 事業奮鬥。這筆高額併購案是否會因黃仁勳的缺席而陷入停滯或生變，已成為開源社群高度關注的焦點。
此外，紅杉資本(Sequoia Capital)合夥人 Shaun Maguire 特別指出，輝達近年在黃仁勳主導下，大幅加碼對「開放原始碼(Open Source)」、「光子學(Photonics)」以及「機器人學(Robotics)」等前沿領域的投資與研發。
Maguire 警告，隨著黃仁勳的離職，這些高度仰賴其個人戰略願景與資源支持的關鍵技術領域，都將深刻感受到失去領導者的重大衝擊。

公司治理教訓與資本市場的兩極化戰線

黃仁勳離職引發的市場地震，迅速將資本市場與治理專家劃分為立場鮮明的兩大戰線。
對於企業高層的劇烈變動，知名風險投資人 Elad Gil 從公司治理的公司運作角度提出警示：「企業應在順境時重置董事會，以避免在逆境時採取突兀的極端行動。」因陷入爭議而於 2017 年迫於壓力辭職的 Uber 前執行長 Travis Kalanick 在互動中對此觀點表示贊同，顯示出矽谷對於創辦人與董事會權力制衡機制的集體反思。

資本市場的看法對比

投資人與 Wall Street 分析師對輝達後續股價與基本面的看法呈現顯著分歧：
Leo KoGuan(新加坡億萬富豪，持股約13億美元)：
「沒有黃仁勳，我不會再增持股票。」主張美國是創造者文明，痛批董事會將監管者凌駕於創造者之上。
Dan Ives(Wedbush 分析師)：
認為董事會別無選擇，但目標價急劇下修：「有黃仁勳的輝達價值 300 美元，沒有他則僅值 225 美元。」
Jim Cramer(CNBC 主持人)：
支持董事會決定，認為舉證過多別無選擇，並高度讚賞代理執行長 Colette Kress 能穩定經營局勢。
Ross Gerber(Gerber Kawasaki 執行長)：
將此時刻類比為賈伯斯離開蘋果，認為 AI 趨勢與輝達發展仍將繼續，此時低點未必是終點。
段永平(知名投資人)：
表態不會賣出股票並賣出大量認售選擇權(Puts)，預測黃仁勳未來可能轉任顧問扮演「影子CEO」，保留實質影響力。

3年回歸預言與輝達的下一步

儘管眼前的風暴尚未平息，科技界已開始議論黃仁勳重返輝達的可能性。
Twitter 前執行長 Dick Costolo 預測，3到4年後，輝達將會有一兩個季度的業績不及市場預期，屆時董事會將會把黃仁勳請回來重新掌舵公司。就像名人的醜聞一樣，大眾憤慨15分鐘後就會淡忘，而美國人最喜歡的，莫過於王者歸來的傳奇故事。」

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉輝達回穩、PPI數據助攻 主要指數漲跌不一
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Early Session: Nvidia Stabilizes, PPI Data Helps, Major Indices Mixed
paras: 美股周五(13日)早盤主要指數漲跌不一。10月生產者物價指數(PPI)月增幅略低於預期，緩解市場對聯準會(Fed)可能大幅升息的擔憂；輝達(NVDA-US)也在近期高層人事風波引發的跌勢後回穩反彈，為市場提供支撐，但未能帶動主要指數同步走高。
歷經本周震盪，標普500指數仍可望寫下8月以來最大單周漲幅，債市則以短天期美債表現較佳。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲近130點或近0.2%，那斯達克綜合指數跌近20點或0.5%，標普 500 指數跌0.02%，費城半導體指數跌近1.5%，台積電ADR漲0.03%。
美股周五走高，最新通膨數據略低於預期，緩解市場對聯準會(Fed)可能大幅升息的擔憂，為本周震盪不安的華爾街帶來喘息空間。
儘管過去幾天市場走勢多有波折，標普500指數仍可望寫下8月以來最大單周漲幅。先前因高層人事風波遭到重挫的輝達(NVDA-US)，周五股價也反彈；美債市場則以短天期公債表現較佳。
美國10月生產者物價指數(PPI)年增率升至2022年以來最高，但本次公布的月增幅略低於市場預期，讓交易員稍微鬆了一口氣。這也顯示，市場短線關注的不只是通膨水準仍高，更在意數據是否足以促使Fed採取更激進的升息行動。
BMO Capital Markets資本市場策略師Vail Hartman指出，雖然Fed在抑制通膨方面仍有許多工作要做，但PPI中會納入央行偏好通膨指標的部分細項，10月表現較弱，有助緩解市場疑慮。Fed偏好的通膨指標為個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)。
不過，官員對物價壓力仍保持警戒。紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯在數據公布前表示，通膨依然偏高，決策官員必須採取進一步行動，才能抑制價格壓力。

paras_en: U.S. stocks on Friday morning (the 13th) saw mixed movements among the major indices. BMO Capital Markets strategist Vail Hartman noted that while the Fed still has a lot of work to do to curb inflation, the PPI includes components the central bank prefers as inflation gauges, and the weaker October reading helps ease market concerns.
