items.title: 川普點名庫克接棒黃仁勳！分析師打臉「機率幾乎為零」 蘋果前執行長為何不該掌舵輝達？
items.title_en: Trump Names Cook to Succeed Jensen Huang! Analysts Say the Chance Is Near Zero
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳捲入婚外情並違反公司行為準則，周四(12日)黯然請辭下台，幾小時過後，與他頗有交情的美國總統川普發文點名蘋果(AAPL-US)前執行長庫克(Tim Cook)接棒，引發熱烈討論。
黃仁勳周四請辭下台後，已由財務長克雷斯(Colette Kress)暫代執行長職務，但輝達尚未確定正式接班人選。
川普周四在Truth Social上發文表示：「既然輝達執行長Jensen Huang已經辭職，而且他原本做得非常出色，接替他的只有一個人──蘋果的庫克。一位傳奇人物接替另一位傳奇人物！」
庫克擔任蘋果執行長長達15年，直到9月1日卸任，由特納斯(John Ternus)接任，目前庫克仍擔任蘋果董事會的執行董事長。

川普看好庫克 分析師認為接任機率極低

庫克在擔任蘋果掌門人的最後兩年，與川普政府建立了密切關係，尤其蘋果承諾未來四年在美國投入數千億美元投資，有助於鞏固雙方關係。
River Wealth Advisor執行長暨管理合夥人Ed O’Gorman說：「庫克擔任蘋果執行長期間，川普與他建立了直接且務實的合作關係，因此川普可能對這段關係感到放心。他也可能認為，庫克接替賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)出任執行長後的成就，證明他有能力接任。」
然而，庫克接下輝達執行長一職的可能性極低。O’Gorman說：「儘管相關新聞引發關注，預測市場也曾短暫出現交易熱度，但這件事實際發生的機率幾乎是零。」
他指出，蘋果與輝達的業務性質截然不同。蘋果是全球最大的消費科技公司，輝達則是製造為科技硬體提供運算能力的晶片。庫克擅長的領域，未必能直接轉化為經營輝達所需的能力。
Equity Armor Investments投資組合經理Joe Tigay也持相同看法，他說：「庫克是一個令人安心的人選，是經過驗證的營運及外交型領導者，也是川普知道如何打交道的人。但我認為，他轉任輝達的可能性非常低。我們應該把這件事視為川普提出的一個人選，而不是當成既定事實，也不應假設這反映了輝達董事會或庫克本人的意願。」

業務基因不同、AI作風過於保守

庫克被視為成功的企業主管，在他擔任執行長期間，蘋果股價飆漲約20倍。他曾推出多項令人印象深刻的產品，包括AirPods與Apple Watch，也大幅改造公司的服務業務。如今的蘋果以黏著度極高的生態系聞名，消費者持續回購產品及使用服務。
《巴隆周刊》(Barron’s)認為，如果庫克選在此時轉而接掌一家正陷入動盪的企業，可能拖累他多年來努力建立的聲譽。
庫克也因蘋果在AI領域的布局受到一些批評。蘋果與AI實驗室合作，推動Apple Intelligence更新，但目前已推出的功能尚未讓消費者眼睛一亮。特納斯接任執行長後所面臨的艱鉅任務之一，就是證明這些AI更新確實有效。
O’Gorman說：「庫克在蘋果應用AI方面相當謹慎，但輝達已經建立起一種有效且勇於承擔風險的工程文化。」
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang became embroiled in an extramarital affair and violated the company’s code of conduct, and on Thursday (the 12th) he resigned in disgrace. Hours later, U.S. President Donald Trump posted that former Apple (AAPL-US) CEO Tim Cook should take over, sparking heated discussion.
After Huang’s resignation on Thursday, CFO Colette Kress has temporarily assumed the CEO duties, but NVIDIA has not yet confirmed a permanent successor.

Trump wrote on Truth Social on Thursday: “Since NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has resigned, and he was doing a great job, there is only one person to replace him – Apple’s Cook. One legend replacing another legend!”
Cook served as Apple’s CEO for 15 years until stepping down on September 1, when John Ternus succeeded him; Cook remains executive chairman of Apple’s board.

Trump backs Cook, but analysts say the odds of him taking the job are extremely low. In Cook’s final two years at Apple he built a close relationship with the Trump administration, especially after Apple pledged to invest hundreds of billions of dollars in the United States over the next four years, strengthening ties between the two sides.

Ed O’Gorman, CEO and managing partner of River Wealth Advisor, said: “During Cook’s tenure as Apple’s CEO, Trump developed a direct and pragmatic working relationship with him, so Trump may feel comfortable with that connection. He may also view Cook’s achievements after succeeding Steve Jobs as proof that he could handle the role.”

However, the likelihood of Cook becoming NVIDIA’s CEO is very low. O’Gorman added: “Although the news generated attention and the market briefly saw some trading activity, the actual probability of this happening is essentially zero.”

He noted that Apple and NVIDIA operate in fundamentally different businesses. Apple is the world’s largest consumer‑technology company, while NVIDIA makes chips that provide compute power for technology hardware. Cook’s expertise may not translate directly into the skills needed to run NVIDIA.

Joe Tigay, portfolio manager at Equity Armor Investments, echoed the view, saying: “Cook is a reassuring choice, a proven operational and diplomatic leader, and someone Trump knows how to deal with. But I think his chances of moving to NVIDIA are very low. We should treat this as a candidate Trump suggested, not as a fact, and not assume it reflects the wishes of NVIDIA’s board or Cook himself.”

Different business DNA and an overly cautious AI approach. Cook is seen as a successful corporate leader; under his tenure Apple’s stock surged roughly twenty‑fold. He launched impressive products such as AirPods and the Apple Watch and dramatically reshaped the company’s services business. Today Apple is known for a highly sticky ecosystem that keeps consumers repeatedly buying products and using services.
Barron’s argued that if Cook were to leave now to head a company in turmoil, it could damage the reputation he has built over many years.

Cook has also faced criticism for Apple’s AI strategy. Apple’s partnership with AI labs to push the Apple Intelligence update has so far delivered features that have not dazzled consumers. One of the tough challenges facing Ternus as the new CEO will be to prove that these AI updates are truly effective.
O’Gorman said: “Cook has been very cautious in applying AI at Apple, whereas NVIDIA has cultivated an effective, risk‑taking engineering culture.”

items.title: Fed仍難鬆口氣！美國10月PPI月增低於預期 年增卻創近四年新高
items.title_en: Fed Still Can't Breathe Easy! US October PPI MoM Below Expectations, YoY Hits Near‑Four‑Year High
paras: 美國10月生產者物價指數(PPI)月增幅略低於預期，但年增率升至6.5%，創2022年11月以來最高，顯示通膨壓力仍難消退。食品、運輸與倉儲成本持續上漲，加上就業市場強勁，使市場維持聯準會(Fed)12月升息的預期，並關注是否可能一口氣升息2碼(50個基點)。
美國勞工統計局(BLS)周五(13日)公布，10月最終需求PPI月增0.3%，低於《路透》調查預估的0.4%；9月月增率則由1.3%上修至1.4%。年增率從9月的6.3%升至6.5%，反映短期漲勢雖放緩，整體價格壓力仍高。

食品與運輸成本續漲 核心通膨仍具黏性

排除食品與能源的核心PPI月增0.3%，符合預期，年增5%。進一步排除波動較大的貿易服務後，PPI月增0.5%、年增4.9%，顯示價格壓力並未侷限於能源與食品。
商品價格月增0.5%，主要受到食品與基本有機化學品帶動。其中，食品批發價格上漲1.3%，為2月以來最大月增幅，中東衝突、俄烏戰爭與關稅等因素持續推升成本。
運輸與倉儲成本繼9月上漲3.4%後，10月再漲2%；能源價格則在前月大漲後小幅回落0.1%，暫時減輕部分壓力，但不足以扭轉整體年增率攀升的趨勢。
服務價格月增0.2%，連續第五個月上升，但因貿易服務價格下跌，漲勢有所放緩。從企業角度來看，上游成本若持續增加，業者將面臨吸收成本、壓縮利潤，或向消費者轉嫁價格的壓力。

12月升息預期未退 市場仍防範一次升2碼

這份報告公布前，美國10月消費者物價漲幅高於預期，非農就業也強勁增加，失業率由4.2%降至4.1%。物價與就業數據共同顯示，Fed尚難對通膨鬆懈。
Fed理事華勒近期的談話，也讓市場在12月升息1碼的主要預期之外，保留升息2碼的可能性，相關機率仍約15%。芝商所FedWatch工具顯示，市場也預期明年1月可能再度升息。Fed上月將基準利率維持在3.75%至4%。
部分PPI細項會納入Fed偏好的個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)，因此後續通膨走勢仍受關注。10月航空票價、醫院門診及醫師照護價格上升，護理之家照護、法律服務與遊戲軟體發行價格則下降，呈現不一走勢。
美國經濟分析局預定11月25日公布10月PCE、個人所得與支出數據，將為Fed於12月9日作出利率決策提供更多依據。
paras_en: The US producer price index (PPI) for October rose slightly less than expected on a monthly basis, but the annual increase climbed to 6.5%, the highest since November 2022, indicating that inflationary pressure remains difficult to dispel. Food, transportation and warehousing costs kept rising, and a strong labour market kept the market expecting a Fed rate hike in December and watching whether a two‑step (50‑basis‑point) increase could happen in one go.

The US Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) released on Friday the 13th that the final demand PPI for October rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, below Reuters’ forecast of 0.4%; September’s monthly increase was revised up from 1.3% to 1.4%. The year‑over‑year rate rose from 6.3% in September to 6.5%, reflecting a short‑term slowdown in the surge but still high overall price pressure.

Food and transportation costs kept climbing, and core inflation remains sticky. Core PPI – excluding food and energy – rose 0.3% month‑over‑month, in line with expectations, and 5% year‑over‑year. Stripping out the more volatile trade services, PPI rose 0.5% month‑over‑month and 4.9% year‑over‑year, showing price pressure is not confined to energy and food.

Commodity prices rose 0.5% month‑over‑month, driven mainly by food and basic organic chemicals. Food wholesale prices jumped 1.3%, the biggest monthly gain since February, as Middle‑East conflicts, the Russia‑Ukraine war and tariffs continued to push costs higher.

Transportation and warehousing costs, after a 3.4% rise in September, increased another 2% in October; energy prices, after a sharp jump the month before, slipped 0.1%, temporarily easing some pressure but not enough to reverse the overall upward trend in the annual rate.

Service prices rose 0.2% month‑over‑month, marking the fifth consecutive month of increase, though the pace slowed as trade‑service prices fell. From a corporate perspective, if upstream costs keep rising, firms will face the dilemma of absorbing costs, squeezing margins, or passing the higher prices onto consumers.

The expectation of a December rate hike has not faded, and the market still guards against a two‑step increase. Before this report was released, US consumer price inflation for October came in higher than expected and non‑farm payrolls added strongly, with the unemployment rate falling from 4.2% to 4.1%. The combination of price and employment data shows the Fed still finds it hard to ease up on inflation.

Fed Governor Waller’s recent remarks have kept the market’s probability of a two‑step (50‑basis‑point) hike in December at about 15%, in addition to the main expectation of a one‑step move. The CME FedWatch tool also shows the market anticipating a possible rate hike again in January next year. The Fed left its policy rate unchanged last month at 3.75%‑4.00%.

Some PPI components feed into the Fed‑preferred personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index, so the future path of inflation remains under close watch. In October, airline ticket prices, hospital outpatient and physician services rose, while nursing‑home care, legal services and video‑game publishing prices fell, showing a mixed picture.

The US Bureau of Economic Analysis is scheduled to release October PCE, personal income and spending data on November 25, which will give the Fed more information for its rate‑decision meeting on December 9.

items.title: AI股跌出買點？高盛看標普上探8700點 點名大型雲端股
items.title_en: AI Stocks Lose Buying Appeal? Goldman Sachs Sees S&P Climbing to 8,700 Points, Highlights Large Cloud Companies
paras: 科技股近期遭遇賣壓，高盛(GS-US)卻認為，大型雲端業者的估值已浮現吸引力。由首席全球股票策略師Peter Oppenheimer領軍的團隊預估，標普500指數未來12個月可望升至8,700點，較報告採用的基準水準上漲約14%。即使2027年企業獲利成長明顯放緩，美股仍有進一步上漲空間。
高盛認為，當市場整體成長速度減慢，能持續擴張獲利的企業將更受投資人青睞。不過，團隊也提醒，未來市場波動可能高於近年水準，選股與產業配置將更加重要。

科技股修正浮現機會 大型雲端業者獲青睞

那斯達克100指數自10月初高點回落約9%，市場對AI基礎建設支出的疑慮，以及輝達(NVDA-US)創辦人黃仁勳離職風波，均壓抑科技股表現。高盛指出，這波修正已使大型雲端業者的估值明顯低於歷史水準，提供具有吸引力的進場機會。
策略師表示，科技股、尤其是大型雲端業者，具有相對防禦性。雖然部分大型企業的現金流已轉負，但淨負債相對股東權益等衡量指標仍健康，加上收入來源多元，有助支撐其因應景氣變化的能力。
這項看法並不代表高盛忽視AI投資風險。團隊預期，大型雲端業者資本支出成長降溫，將成為明年企業獲利增速放緩的原因之一，但市場已提前反映部分疑慮，使相關股票的投資吸引力回升。
高盛也看見記憶體及其他半導體等景氣循環成長股的上漲潛力，但提醒這類股票風險較高、波動也更劇烈，不能與大型雲端業者一概而論。

獲利成長放緩 聚焦成長股與精選防禦族群

高盛預估，標普500企業每股盈餘成長率將由2026年的36%，降至2027年的11%；歐洲Stoxx 600指數企業則由18%降至7%。除了AI資本支出成長降溫，能源與原物料企業獲利預期下修，也是拖累因素。醫療保健則是報告中唯一預期明年獲利成長率將加快的產業。
不過，獲利成長減速不代表牛市必然結束。高盛認為，當成長機會變得稀缺，投資人將願意為能維持成長的企業支付更高估值，價值較仰賴長期獲利的成長股也可望受惠。
在選股方向上，高盛聚焦三類機會：具有持續成長能力的企業、精選防禦股，以及受惠美債殖利率與能源價格下降的族群。大型雲端業者、能透過AI創造營收的公司，以及能源設備與服務業者，均列入其關注的成長股範圍。
防禦配置方面，高盛看好醫療保健及長期穩定實施庫藏股的企業；若油價與美債殖利率回落，運輸業與長期成長股也可望受惠。
區域配置上，高盛對美國與日本股市維持加碼，對新興市場與亞洲整體持中立立場，並減碼歐洲。團隊指出，歐股估值修正幅度不如其他地區，加上政府債務問題與密集政治議程，使風險相對偏高。
paras_en: Technology stocks have recently faced selling pressure, but Goldman Sachs (GS-US) believes valuations of large cloud providers are becoming attractive. Led by chief global equity strategist Peter Oppenheimer, the team projects the S&P 500 could rise to 8,700 points over the next 12 months, about a 14% increase from the baseline used in the report. Even with corporate earnings growth slowing markedly by 2027, U.S. equities still have upside potential.

Goldman Sachs argues that as overall market growth slows, companies that can continue expanding profits will be favored by investors. However, the team also warns that future market volatility may exceed recent levels, making stock selection and sector allocation even more important.

Tech stock corrections present opportunities; large cloud providers gain favor. The Nasdaq‑100 has fallen about 9% from its early‑October peak, as concerns over AI infrastructure spending and the fallout from NVIDIA (NVDA-US) founder Jensen Huang’s departure have weighed on tech stocks. Goldman Sachs notes that this correction has pushed large cloud companies’ valuations well below historical norms, offering an attractive entry point.

Strategists say tech stocks, especially large cloud providers, have relative defensive qualities. Although cash flow at some big firms has turned negative, metrics such as net debt to equity remain healthy, and diversified revenue streams help support their ability to weather economic shifts.

This view does not mean Goldman Sachs ignores AI investment risks. The team expects capital‑expenditure growth at large cloud providers to cool, which will be one reason corporate earnings growth slows next year, but the market has already priced in some concerns, restoring the investment appeal of those stocks.

Goldman Sachs also sees upside potential in cyclical growth stocks such as memory and other semiconductors, but cautions that these stocks carry higher risk and greater volatility and should not be lumped together with large cloud providers.

Earnings growth slows, focus shifts to growth stocks and select defensive groups. Goldman Sachs forecasts that S&P 500 earnings per share growth will drop from 36% in 2026 to 11% in 2027, while the European Stoxx 600 will fall from 18% to 7%. In addition to a cooling of AI cap‑ex, lower profit expectations for energy and raw‑material firms are drag factors, whereas healthcare is the only sector the report expects to accelerate earnings growth next year.

However, slower earnings growth does not mean the bull market must end. Goldman Sachs believes that when growth opportunities become scarce, investors will be willing to pay higher multiples for companies that can sustain growth, allowing long‑term earnings‑driven growth stocks to benefit.

In terms of stock selection, Goldman Sachs focuses on three opportunity types: companies with sustainable growth, select defensive stocks, and groups that benefit from falling U.S. Treasury yields and energy prices. Large cloud providers, firms that can generate revenue through AI, and energy equipment and services companies are all on its growth‑stock watch list.

For defensive positioning, Goldman Sachs favors healthcare and companies with a long‑term, stable share‑repurchase program; if oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields retreat, transportation and long‑term growth stocks could also benefit.

Regionally, Goldman Sachs maintains overweight positions in the United States and Japan, stays neutral on emerging markets and Asia overall, and reduces exposure to Europe. The team notes that European equities have seen less valuation correction than other regions, and combined with sovereign debt issues and a crowded political agenda, the risk profile is relatively higher.

items.title: 黃仁勳離職衝擊擴大？中國32億美元AI計畫面臨晶片斷供風險
items.title_en: Jensen Huang's Departure May Widen Impact? China's $3.2 Billion AI Project Faces Chip Supply‑Cut Risk
paras: 黃仁勳離開輝達(NVDA-US)後，衝擊恐進一步波及中國AI建設。《路透》周五(13日)公布調查指出，中國總值逾元人民幣230億(約32億美元)的運算專案及設備協議，仍以受到美國出口限制的輝達晶片為核心。隨著華府加強審查，相關計畫恐面臨供應中斷、工程延誤，甚至被迫花費鉅資改用中國國產晶片。
黃仁勳長期主張放寬晶片出口限制，他的離職可能削弱輝達對華府的遊說力量。在美國國會議員推動加強管制之際，中國業者取得先進AI晶片的前景也增添變數。

中國AI建設仍仰賴輝達 需求延伸至大學與地方政府

《路透》檢視逾150份中國採購公告、投資計畫、建設合約及企業揭露文件，發現輝達技術的應用範圍遠超過大型科技企業，還深入地方政府支持的企業、大學及區域運算中心，從沿海科技重鎮延伸至偏遠西部省份。
相關專案以H100、H200及H800等受出口限制的處理器為核心設計，涵蓋大型區域運算中心及既有商業設施改建案。例如，甘肅一處設施原預計年底前安裝數千顆輝達晶片，但目前仍不清楚是否已經到貨。
上述32億美元估算包含規劃中的投資、已簽署合約及完成安裝的設施，也涵蓋建築物、電力系統等基礎建設，並非全數用於購買輝達晶片。
黃仁勳去年曾表示，輝達在中國市占率已從95%降至零；公司也因監管不確定性，將中國資料中心運算營收排除在財測之外。不過，這些說法反映輝達直接銷售與競爭的處境，不代表中國需求消失。文件顯示，中國客戶仍規劃採購，部分設施已使用受限處理器。

出口審查升溫 供應受阻恐迫使業者改用國產晶片

美國自2022年起限制輝達先進AI晶片出口，之後將管制擴及為中國市場調整設計的H800。今年1月，川普政府則對符合資格的中國客戶採取附帶條件、逐案審查H200出口許可的方式。
部分中國專案已營運或施工，但若管制收緊，業者可能被迫延後工程，或重新設計系統以搭配國產晶片。華盛頓智庫詹姆斯敦基金會分析師Sunny Cheung表示，美方應追查最終使用運算資源的對象與用途，而非僅關注表面上的晶片買家。
《路透》另引述IDC估計，輝達占2026年上半年中國AI加速器出貨量的34%。不過，這與輝達對自身市場處境的描述採用不同衡量方式，也無法據此判定受限晶片如何流入中國。
黃仁勳周四辭任後，美方對相關事件的審視升溫。涉及爭議的新加坡雲端合作夥伴Megaspeed否認非法轉運輝達晶片至中國；輝達董事會已啟動獨立調查，並表示目前沒有理由認為公司機密或美國國安受到損害。
目前並無公開調查結論認定黃仁勳違反出口管制法律，《路透》發現的中國專案也未被證實與Megaspeed或黃仁勳相關指控有關。中國商務部與輝達未立即回應置評請求。
paras_en: After Jensen Huang left Nvidia (NVDA-US), the shock may further ripple into China's AI construction. Reuters on Friday (the 13th) reported that China's computing projects and equipment contracts worth over 230 billion yuan (about $3.2 billion) still rely on Nvidia chips subject to U.S. export restrictions. As Washington tightens its review, the related projects could face supply interruptions, engineering delays, or even be forced to spend huge sums to switch to domestically‑made chips.

Huang has long advocated loosening chip export limits, and his exit could weaken Nvidia's lobbying power in Washington. While U.S. lawmakers push for stricter controls, the outlook for Chinese firms obtaining advanced AI chips becomes more uncertain.

China's AI build‑out still depends on Nvidia, with demand extending to universities and local governments. Reuters examined more than 150 Chinese procurement notices, investment plans, construction contracts and corporate disclosures, finding Nvidia technology used far beyond large tech firms – it reaches enterprises backed by local governments, universities and regional computing centers, stretching from coastal tech hubs to remote western provinces.

The projects centre on export‑restricted processors such as the H100, H200 and H800, covering large regional computing centers and retrofits of existing commercial facilities. For example, a site in Gansu had planned to install thousands of Nvidia chips by year‑end, but it is still unclear whether the chips have arrived.

The $3.2 billion estimate includes planned investments, signed contracts and installed facilities, as well as infrastructure such as buildings and power systems – it is not all spent on buying Nvidia chips.

Huang said last year that Nvidia's market share in China had fallen from 95% to zero, and the company excluded Chinese data‑center computing revenue from its forecasts because of regulatory uncertainty. However, those statements reflect Nvidia's direct sales and competitive situation and do not mean Chinese demand has vanished. Documents show Chinese customers still plan purchases, and some facilities already use restricted processors.

Export scrutiny has intensified, threatening supply and possibly forcing firms to switch to domestic chips. The U.S. has restricted Nvidia's advanced AI chip exports since 2022 and later expanded controls to the H800, which is tailored for the Chinese market. In January, the Trump administration introduced case‑by‑case, conditional review of H200 export licences for qualified Chinese customers.

Some Chinese projects are already operating or under construction, but tighter controls could force operators to delay work or redesign systems to accommodate domestic chips. Sunny Cheung, an analyst at the James Town Foundation, said Washington should trace the ultimate users and purposes of the computing resources rather than focusing only on the apparent chip buyers.

Reuters also cited IDC's estimate that Nvidia will account for 34% of AI accelerator shipments in China in the first half of 2026. However, this metric differs from Nvidia's own market‑position descriptions and cannot be used to determine how restricted chips are flowing into China.

After Huang stepped down on Thursday, U.S. scrutiny of related matters heightened. Singapore cloud partner Megaspeed, involved in a disputed deal, denied illegally shipping Nvidia chips to China; Nvidia's board has launched an independent investigation and said there is currently no reason to believe company secrets or U.S. national security have been compromised.

No public investigation has concluded that Huang violated export‑control laws, and the Chinese projects Reuters identified have not been proven to be linked to Megaspeed or the allegations against Huang. China's Ministry of Commerce and Nvidia did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

items.title: 輝達自高點回檔逾30% 高盛引蘋果先例：當前風險報酬比具吸引力
items.title_en: Nvidia Slides Over 30% From Peak as Goldman Cites Apple Precedent: Current Risk‑Reward Ratio Appealing
paras: AI晶片龍頭輝達(NVDA-US)自10月6日創下239.24美元的歷史高點以來，股價累計回檔已超過30%，市值蒸發高達1.6兆美元，並將全球市值王座重新讓予蘋果(AAPL-US)。在執行長黃仁勳離職風波與華爾街拋售潮衝擊下，輝達面臨連續第六周下跌，創下2012年以來最長的周連跌紀錄，盤中一度下挫至148.80美元低點。
面對市場恐慌，高盛(分析師團隊在最新報告中，提出十多年前蘋果的歷史經驗作為對照。高盛指出，2011年初蘋果創辦人賈伯斯(Steve Jobs)因病請假並離世後，蘋果的預估本益比在18個月內由17倍壓縮至12倍，2013年更曾微跌至9倍附近，直到市場對iPhone與生態系的創新執行力重拾信心後才回升至15倍。
高盛強調，兩家公司狀況雖不完全相同，但均具備堅實的技術領先與競爭壁壘。
基本面上，高盛預估輝達2027年每股盈餘(EPS)將達16.70美元，高於市場共識的15.91美元，對應預估本益比僅約9.6倍。搭配約80%的預估盈餘成長率，高盛認為當前股價已展現極具吸引力的風險報酬比。
華爾街其他知名分析師中，被譽為「華爾街預言家」的 Fundstrat 全球顧問公司共同創辦人兼研究主管Tom Lee立場更為強硬，明確建議投資人應「逢低買進輝達」。Lee認為，即便黃仁勳卸任，輝達依然是全球最重要的企業，股價回檔反而是進場良機。
相對而言，DA Davidson 董事總經理Gil Luria則抱持較為審慎但樂觀的態度。Luria在報告中表示，鑑於執行長黃仁勳突然離職，輝達未來數月將面臨具挑戰性的過渡期；因此他將輝達目標價由300美元下修至200美元，但仍維持「買進」評級，並指出市場目前已針對高層過渡期的風險進行了適當價格調整。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US), the AI‑chip leader, has fallen more than 30% since hitting its all‑time high of $239.24 on October 6, wiping out about $1.6 trillion in market value and handing the title of world’s most valuable company back to Apple (AAPL‑US). Amid CEO Jensen Huang’s departure turmoil and a Wall Street sell‑off, Nvidia has logged a sixth consecutive week of declines – the longest weekly losing streak since 2012 – and briefly dropped to a low of $148.80 during intraday trading.

In response to market panic, Goldman Sachs’ analyst team cited Apple’s historical experience from more than a decade ago as a comparison in its latest report. Goldman noted that after co‑founder Steve Jobs took a medical leave and passed away in early 2011, Apple’s forward price‑to‑earnings multiple compressed from 17× to 12× within 18 months and even slipped to around 9× in 2013, only rebounding to 15× once confidence returned to the iPhone and ecosystem’s innovation engine.
Goldman emphasized that, while the two companies are not identical, both possess solid technological leadership and strong competitive moats.

Fundamentally, Goldman projects Nvidia’s 2027 earnings per share to reach $16.70, above the consensus estimate of $15.91, implying an implied P/E of roughly 9.6×. Coupled with an estimated earnings growth rate of about 80%, Goldman believes the current share price offers a highly attractive risk‑reward profile.

Among other Wall Street analysts, Tom Lee – co‑founder and head of research at Fundstrat, often dubbed the “Wall Street prophet” – takes an even more bullish stance, explicitly urging investors to “buy Nvidia on dips.” Lee argues that even if Huang steps down, Nvidia remains the world’s most important company and the pull‑back in price presents a good entry point.

In contrast, Gil Luria, managing director at D.A. Davidson, adopts a more cautious yet optimistic view. Luria notes that Huang’s sudden exit will likely create a challenging transition period for Nvidia over the coming months; consequently, he has lowered his target price from $300 to $200 but still maintains a “Buy” rating, pointing out that the market has already priced in the leadership‑transition risk appropriately.

items.title: 黃仁勳走了還沒完！美財長開砲商務部 輝達也得說清楚
items.title_en: Nvidia’s Turmoil Continues After Jensen Huang’s Exit: Treasury Secretary Slams Commerce Dept, Nvidia Must Clarify
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)風波進一步延燒至川普政府內部。據《金融時報》與《彭博》報導，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)公開表示，財政部等多個部門數月來一直支持將Megaspeed列入貿易黑名單，但決策權掌握在商務部手中。他也要求追究輝達相關人員的責任，質疑公司是否充分查核客戶並防止晶片流入中國。
這番發言讓商務部長盧特尼克(Howard Lutnick)承受更大壓力。Megaspeed涉嫌將輝達晶片走私至中國的調查已持續一年多，而黃仁勳因涉及與美方懷疑具有中國情報背景的黃樂(Alice Huang)發生婚外情而辭任，使晶片出口審查與企業內控問題成為華府焦點。

多部門早支持列入黑名單 貝森特將矛頭指向商務部

貝森特接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，財政部、美國貿易代表署及國務院，數月來都贊成將Megaspeed列入實體清單，但「主導權在商務部」，外界應向商務部詢問內部處理程序。
《金融時報》本周稍早報導，商務部曾延後將Megaspeed列入黑名單的相關作業。實體清單是美國出口管制工具之一，美國企業若要向名單內公司出口受管制產品，須取得商務部許可，以防先進技術落入中國軍方手中。
對於是否曾就此事與盧特尼克當面交鋒，貝森特未正面回應，僅表示：「我們不會重述戰情室內的對話。」
貝森特說，川普已明確表示，中國不應取得比H100更先進的輝達晶片，因此任何外流都令人沮喪，既傷害美國企業，也可能讓中國在AI競賽中取得優勢。
被問及是否需要改變晶片出口政策時，他強調，政府已具備所需權限，重點是落實執行，暗示問題並非缺乏管制工具，而是現有措施是否確實執行。

國會施壓盧特尼克 輝達客戶審查也遭追問

國會對商務部的壓力同步升高。共和黨議員要求盧特尼克赴國會作證，民主黨高層則要求他保存相關文件，以供後續調查。據《彭博》報導，盧特尼克已同意作證。
參議院銀行委員會民主黨首席議員華倫要求，盧特尼克必須說明為何尚未堵住出口管制漏洞，並立即採取行動，確保美國先進技術不會助長中國軍力。不過，川普目前仍公開支持盧特尼克，在輝達宣布黃仁勳辭職後表達對他的信任。
貝森特也將問責焦點指向輝達，質疑公司是否真正了解客戶，以及是否採取充分措施，確保晶片沒有外流、買家並非僅供轉手交易的空殼公司。他表示，公司內應對相關問題負責的人，都必須受到追究。
此外，貝森特點名曾介入美國政府調查Megaspeed涉嫌走私AI晶片案的輝達法務長Tim Teter，批評他應加強監督，而非一味責難調查。他並預期，輝達董事會將對事件展開徹底調查。
上述發言進一步擴大問責範圍，但貝森特對客戶審查與晶片外流的質疑，並不等同於已認定輝達或相關人員違法。
paras_en: The Nvidia (NVDA-US) controversy has further spread within the Trump administration. According to the Financial Times and Bloomberg, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent publicly said that the Treasury and several other agencies have been supporting the inclusion of Megaspeed on the trade blacklist for months, but the decision authority rests with the Commerce Department. He also called for holding Nvidia personnel accountable, questioning whether the company has adequately vetted customers and prevented chips from flowing to China.

The remarks put Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick under greater pressure. The investigation into Megaspeed’s alleged smuggling of Nvidia chips to China has been ongoing for more than a year, and Jensen Huang’s resignation amid allegations of an affair with Alice Huang, who is suspected of having Chinese intelligence ties, has made chip export reviews and corporate internal controls a focus in Washington.

Multiple agencies had early support for blacklisting Megaspeed; Bessent points the finger at Commerce. In an interview with CNBC, Bessent said the Treasury, the U.S. Trade Representative’s office and the State Department have for months agreed to place Megaspeed on the Entity List, but “the lead authority is the Commerce Department,” and outsiders should ask Commerce about its internal procedures.

The Financial Times reported earlier this week that Commerce had delayed actions to add Megaspeed to the blacklist. The Entity List is one of the U.S. export‑control tools; U.S. firms must obtain a Commerce Department license to export controlled products to listed companies, to prevent advanced technology from reaching the Chinese military.
When asked whether he had confronted Lutnick directly about the matter, Bessent gave no direct answer, saying only, “We will not repeat the dialogue that took place in the war room.”

Bessent said Trump has made it clear that China should not obtain Nvidia chips more advanced than the H100, so any leakage is disappointing, harming U.S. companies and potentially giving China an edge in the AI race.

When questioned about whether chip‑export policy needs to change, he emphasized that the government already has the necessary authority; the issue is implementation, implying the problem is not a lack of tools but whether existing measures are being enforced.

Congress ramps up pressure on Lutnick; Nvidia’s customer vetting also comes under scrutiny. Republican lawmakers are demanding Lutnick testify before Congress, while senior Democrats want him to preserve relevant documents for further investigation. Bloomberg reports that Lutnick has agreed to testify.

Senate Banking Committee Democratic Chair Warren has asked Lutnick to explain why export‑control gaps have not been closed and to act immediately to ensure U.S. advanced technology does not bolster Chinese military power. However, Trump continues to publicly back Lutnick, expressing confidence in him after Nvidia announced Huang’s resignation.

Bessent also shifted accountability onto Nvidia, questioning whether the company truly understands its customers and has taken sufficient steps to ensure chips do not leak and that buyers are not merely shell companies for resale. He said anyone at Nvidia responsible for these issues must be held accountable.

He further singled out Nvidia’s chief legal officer Tim Teter, who had been involved in the government’s investigation of Megaspeed’s alleged AI‑chip smuggling, criticizing him for needing to strengthen oversight rather than merely blaming the probe, and he expects Nvidia’s board to conduct a thorough investigation.
These comments broaden the scope of accountability, but Bessent’s doubts about customer vetting and chip leakage do not equate to a legal finding that Nvidia or its personnel have violated the law.

items.title: 盤中速報 - 安可(AMKR-US)大跌5.01%，報35.26美元
items.title_en: Intraday Update - Amkor Technology (AMKR-US) drops 5.01% to $35.26

items.title_en: <New York Forex Market> Dollar Rises to 19-Month High, Market Focus Shifts to Rate Expectations
paras: 美元週四(12日)走強，升至約19個月以來最高水準。由於投資人重新評估聯準會（Fed）未來的利率政策走向，市場對聯準會採取更強硬升息立場的預期升高，進而推升美國公債殖利率。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.3%，報103.16，仍維持在2025年4月以來的最高水準。
本週多位聯準會官員警告，通膨仍維持在頑強的高檔水準。其中一些官員表示，如果物價壓力未能緩解，他們不排除升息50個基點的可能性。
週二公布的美國通膨數據強於預期，進一步強化了這項看法，也促使交易員提高對聯準會進一步緊縮貨幣政策的預期。
歐元兌美元下跌0.28%，至1歐元兌1.10585美元，創下2025年4月以來最低。
美元兌瑞士法郎上漲0.14%，至0.834瑞郎，達到一個月以來新高。
Moneycorp交易與結構性商品部門主管 Eugene Epstein 表示，「美元走強幾乎完全是受到市場對聯準會政策預期的影響。如果觀察聯邦基金利率期貨，過去幾天它與美元走勢之間的相關性相當高。而聯邦基金利率期貨之所以走高，主要有兩個原因：（一）消費者物價指數（CPI）高於預期；（二）多位聯準會官員發表了相當多偏鷹的言論。」
根據芝商所（CME） FedWatch 工具，投資人目前預估聯準會在12月升息的機率已達91%。通常會隨聯準會利率預期同步變動的美國2年期公債殖利率，最新上升10.79個基點，來到4.835%。美國10年期公債殖利率則上升7.94個基點，來到5.068%。
包括高盛在內的一些券商，目前甚至預期聯準會除了12月升息之外，明年初還可能再升息一次。
日元走勢
日本最高貨幣外交官三村淳（Atsushi Mimura）週四警告市場參與者，對於今年夏季日本政府曾進場干預匯市一事，「現在還不是可以忘記的時候」。
由於日元再次逼近1美元兌160日元重要關卡，市場對日本政府可能再次干預匯市的警戒也隨之升高。
根據《路透社》一項分析師調查，許多分析師預期，日本央行（BoJ）最快可能在下個月升息。週四公布數據也進一步強化了這項看法。數據顯示，日本10月份批發物價年增率重新加速至7.1%，高於9月份的6.8%。
日元兌美元下跌0.13%，至1美元兌159.975日元，創下9月以來最低水準。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Thursday (the 12th), climbing to its highest level in about 19 months. Investors reassessed the Fed’s future rate policy trajectory, raising expectations that the Fed will adopt a more aggressive rate‑hike stance, which in turn pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.3% to 103.16, still holding its peak since April 2025.
Several Fed officials this week warned that inflation remains stubbornly high. Some officials said that if price pressures do not ease, they would not rule out a 50‑basis‑point rate hike.
U.S. inflation data released on Tuesday came in stronger than expected, reinforcing that view and prompting traders to raise expectations for further tightening by the Fed.
The euro fell 0.28% against the dollar to $1.10585 per euro, a low not seen since April 2025.
The dollar rose 0.14% against the Swiss franc to 0.834 franc, a one‑month high.

Eugene Epstein, head of Moneycorp’s trading and structured products division, said, “The dollar’s strength is almost entirely driven by market expectations of Fed policy. Looking at fed‑fund futures, the correlation with the dollar’s move has been very high over the past few days. Fed‑fund futures are rising for two main reasons: (1) CPI came in above expectations; (2) a number of Fed officials have made decidedly hawkish comments.”

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, investors now see a 91% probability that the Fed will raise rates in December. The U.S. 2‑year Treasury yield, which usually moves in step with Fed‑rate expectations, rose 10.79 basis points to 4.835%. The 10‑year yield climbed 7.94 basis points to 5.068%.
Some brokerages, including Goldman Sachs, now even expect that, besides a December hike, the Fed could deliver another rate increase early next year.
Yen movement

Japan’s top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura warned market participants on Thursday that, regarding the government’s intervention in the foreign‑exchange market during this summer, “the time to forget it has not yet arrived.”
As the yen again approached the critical 160‑per‑dollar threshold, market vigilance over a possible renewed intervention by the Japanese government rose.

A Reuters analyst poll shows many analysts expect the Bank of Japan could raise rates as early as next month. Thursday’s data further reinforced that view, with October wholesale price inflation accelerating to 7.1% year‑on‑year, up from 6.8% in September.
The yen slipped 0.13% to 159.975 per dollar, its lowest level since September.
The Australian dollar fell 0.58% to $0.6808, its lowest since January this year.
The New Zealand dollar dropped 0.25% to $0.5548.

items.title: 日元逼近160關卡！日本匯率主管再警告市場勿忘夏季干預 暗示可能單獨出手
items.title_en: Yen Nearing the 160 Barrier! Japan's Exchange Rate Chief Warns Market Not to Forget Summer Intervention, Hints at Possible Solo Action
paras: 日元兌美元匯率再度逼近160這個日本當局曾出手干預的重要關卡之際，日本最高外匯事務官員三村淳(Atsushi Mimura)周四(12日)警告市場參與者，「現在還不是忘記今年夏季干預行動的時候」，顯示日本當局已準備好再次出手干預，以支撐日元。
日本財務省主管匯率事務的最高官員三村淳說：「我強烈感覺到，過去幾天的匯率波動速度太快了。」他並表示：「現在還不是忘記今年夏天發生什麼事的時候。」不過，他沒有針對特定匯率水準發表評論。
這是三村淳自9月底以來首度針對外匯市場發表談話，而他所指的是日本7月底至8月初買進日元的干預行動，包括與美國聯手進場的操作。
三村淳發出警告之際，日元兌美元匯率周四盤中一度升至159.94，創逾兩個月來新高。日元先前貶破160關卡之後，日本當局7月曾連續三天進場支撐日元，其中一部分還是與美國協調進行的。夏季那波為期三天的干預行動協助日元兌美元匯率從貶破163，回升至最高155.23。
在聯手干預行動後，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與日本財務大臣片山皋月曾警告，當局已準備好再次採取行動，以因應匯市波動。

日元走弱推升進口成本 日本通膨壓力升高

日元疲軟一直是日本決策官員面臨的棘手問題，這導致進口成本大幅攀升。周四公布的數據顯示，以日元計價的進口物價指數10月年增24.8%。
美國通膨數據偏熱，加上聯準會(Fed)官員發表鷹派談話，讓市場愈來愈預期美國將升息，帶動美元走強。而在市場預期美日利差將進一步擴大的情況下，日元再度蒙受壓力。
日本方面，市場已大致消化日本銀行(BOJ，央行)將在12月18日至19日會議升息的預期。但後續升息時程仍不明朗，因為市場預期日本政策利率將逐步接近中性利率水準。
瑞穗證券分析師說：「美國經濟展現韌性，加上人工智慧(AI)投資強勁帶動通膨持續處於高檔，美元兌日元匯率可能繼續走高。」
報告指出：「如果美元突破160關卡，且日元進一步走弱推升通膨，增加首相高市早苗政府支持度下滑的風險，東京當局可能採取單方面干預行動。」
paras_en: The yen‑dollar exchange rate is once again approaching the 160 level, a key threshold where Japanese authorities have previously intervened, and Japan's top foreign‑exchange official Atsushi Mimura warned market participants on Thursday (the 12th) that "now is not the time to forget this summer's intervention action," indicating that the authorities are ready to step in again to support the yen.

Mimura, the senior official in charge of exchange‑rate matters at the Ministry of Finance, said, "I strongly feel that the speed of exchange‑rate fluctuations over the past few days has been too rapid," adding, "Now is not the time to forget what happened this summer." He did not comment on any specific exchange‑rate level.

This is Mimura's first public comment on the FX market since the end of September, referring to Japan's July‑late‑August early‑August yen‑buying intervention, which was carried out in coordination with the United States.

When Mimura issued his warning, the yen‑dollar rate rose intraday on Thursday to 159.94, a two‑month high. After the yen slipped past the 160 barrier, Japanese authorities intervened for three consecutive days in July, part of which was coordinated with the U.S. That three‑day summer intervention helped lift the yen from a dip below 163 back up to a peak of 155.23.

Following the joint intervention, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Japanese Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki warned that the authorities were prepared to act again in response to market volatility.
A weaker yen is pushing up import costs, raising inflation pressure in Japan. Data released on Thursday showed that the import price index, measured in yen, rose 24.8% year‑on‑year in October.

U.S. inflation data remains hot and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials have heightened expectations of further U.S. rate hikes, strengthening the dollar. With markets expecting the Japan‑U.S. interest‑rate gap to widen, the yen faces renewed pressure.

In Japan, markets have largely priced in expectations that the Bank of Japan will raise rates at its meeting on December 18‑19, but the timing of any further hikes remains unclear as markets anticipate the policy rate moving gradually toward a neutral level.
Mizuho Securities analysts said, "The U.S. economy is showing resilience, and strong AI‑driven investment is keeping inflation at elevated levels, so the dollar‑yen pair may continue to rise."

The report noted, "If the dollar breaks the 160 barrier and the yen weakens further, pushing up inflation and increasing the risk of declining support for Prime Minister Kishida's government, Tokyo authorities may resort to unilateral intervention."

paras: 美國通膨持續升溫，加上聯準會（Fed）官員接連釋出鷹派訊號，市場升息預期急速升溫，ICE 美元指數周三（11 日）一度升至 102.96，創下 19 個月新高。
隨著交易員開始押注聯準會 12 月可能一口氣升息 2 碼，短期美債殖利率飆升，全球主要貨幣普遍承壓，美元漲勢成為市場關注焦點。
隨著交易員開始將聯準會 12 月升息 2 碼納入定價，美債殖利率走揚、全球主要貨幣承壓，美元成為金融市場關注焦點。
行情數據顯示，衡量美元兌一籃子主要貨幣表現的 ICE 美元指數(DXY) ，周三盤中最高觸及 102.96，創下 2025 年 4 月以來最高水準。
另一項廣受市場關注的彭博美元指數，也創下今年 6 月以來最大兩日漲幅，盤中觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最高水準。美元當天兌幾乎所有主要貨幣均走強，顯示買盤持續湧入。
美元本波漲勢在周二明顯加速，主要受到美國通膨數據與聯準會官員鷹派言論雙重推動。
最新數據顯示，美國 10 月消費者物價漲幅連續第三個月高於市場預期，促使交易員重新評估聯準會未來升息幅度，甚至開始將 12 月一次升息 50 個基點（2 碼）的可能性納入定價。
隨著短期美債殖利率飆升，美國與其他主要經濟體之間的利差擴大，進一步吸引追求較高報酬的資金流向美元資產。
12月升息1碼機率達88% 華爾街上修預測
加拿大帝國商業銀行（CIBC）策略師 Jeremy Stretch 表示，美元近期走強，核心原因在於市場持續重新調整對聯準會貨幣政策路徑的預期。
他指出，無論是聯準會一次升息 50 個基點，或加快目前每季升息一次的緊縮步伐，如今都已成為市場實際討論的政策選項。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，周三貨幣市場預估，聯準會 12 月升息 25 個基點的機率達 88%，升息 50 個基點的機率則為 12%。
在周二通膨數據公布後，華爾街主要券商也陸續調整利率預測。
高盛目前預估，聯準會將分別在今年 12 月及明年 3 月升息；德意志銀行則預期，聯準會將在今年 12 月、明年 1 月及 3 月連續升息，顯示市場對貨幣政策進一步緊縮的預期正在升高。
美元還能漲多高？市場緊盯PPI數據
不過，在 12 月升息逐漸成為市場基本預期後，美元能否進一步突破高點，仍取決於後續經濟數據與聯準會政策訊號。
DHF Capital 資產經理 Bas Kooijman 表示，若美元要延續漲勢，市場可能需要進一步提高對聯準會升息 50 個基點的押注。
他指出，若周五公布的美國生產者物價指數（PPI）再度高於預期，或聯準會官員持續釋出鷹派訊號，可能進一步推升美債殖利率，帶動美元突破近期高點。
反之，若經濟數據轉弱，或投資人對大幅升息的預期降溫，美元可能回吐部分漲幅。
值得注意的是，美國公債市場周三因退伍軍人節假期休市。
歐元跌破1.11 法國債務問題再添壓力
美元強勢走高，也持續對其他主要貨幣形成壓力。
今年以來，除了澳元與挪威克朗之外，多數 G10 已開發市場貨幣兌美元均呈現貶值，反映美國與其他經濟體之間不斷擴大的利差。
部分分析師也認為，今年美元的強勢表現，部分來自美國與以色列對伊朗戰爭期間湧入的避險資金。
其中，歐元承受的壓力尤其明顯。
歐元兌美元隔夜下跌 0.65%，跌破 1.11 美元關卡，延續前一交易日跌勢，並觸及 2025 年 5 月以來最低水準。
除了美元走強，法國債務問題持續拖累歐元，加上近期油價回落，市場對歐洲央行升息的預期也有所降溫。
荷蘭合作銀行（Rabobank）外匯策略師 Jane Foley 指出，歐洲央行上次新聞發布會透露，管理委員會對經濟成長前景的擔憂日益加深。
她表示，另一項可能在未來數月壓抑歐元的因素，是明年法國總統大選帶來的政治不確定性。若極右派候選人當選總統，可能對歐盟未來合作方向產生影響。
荷蘭合作銀行預估，歐元兌美元將在未來三個月內進一步跌至 1.10。
隨著聯準會升息預期持續升溫，市場接下來將密切關注美國通膨數據與官員談話，判斷美元是否仍有進一步走強的空間。
paras_en: U.S. inflation continues to heat up, and Fed officials have been issuing hawkish signals, causing rate‑hike expectations to surge. The ICE Dollar Index rose to 102.96 on Wednesday (the 11th), hitting a 19‑month peak.

As traders began betting that the Fed could raise rates by two full points in December, short‑term U.S. Treasury yields spiked, major currencies worldwide came under pressure, and the dollar’s rally became the market’s focal point.
With traders pricing in a two‑point Fed hike in December, Treasury yields climbed, major currencies were pressured, and the dollar took center stage in financial markets.
Market data show that the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the dollar against a basket of major currencies, reached a intraday high of 102.96 on Wednesday, the highest level since April 2025.

Another widely‑watched gauge, the Bloomberg Dollar Index, also posted its biggest two‑day gain since June this year, touching its highest level since May 2025. The dollar strengthened against almost all major currencies, indicating continued buying pressure.
The dollar’s current rally accelerated noticeably on Tuesday, driven by a combination of U.S. inflation data and hawkish comments from Fed officials.

The latest data show that U.S. consumer price inflation for October was higher than market expectations for the third consecutive month, prompting traders to reassess the Fed’s future rate‑hike magnitude and even start pricing in a possible 50‑basis‑point (two‑point) hike in December.
As short‑term Treasury yields surged, the yield gap between the United States and other major economies widened, further attracting funds seeking higher returns into dollar‑denominated assets.
Probability of a one‑point December hike reaches 88% as Wall Street revises forecasts.
CIBC strategist Jeremy Stretch said the dollar’s recent strength is mainly due to the market’s ongoing recalibration of expectations for the Fed’s monetary‑policy path.
He noted that whether the Fed raises rates by 50 basis points in a single move or accelerates its current quarterly‑rate‑hike cadence, both options are now being seriously discussed in the market.

According to London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) data, Wednesday’s currency‑market estimates put the probability of a 25‑basis‑point Fed hike in December at 88%, while a 50‑basis‑point hike was seen at 12%.
After Tuesday’s inflation data release, major Wall Street brokerages began adjusting their rate forecasts.

Goldman Sachs now expects the Fed to raise rates in both December this year and March next year; Deutsche Bank forecasts hikes in December, January and March, indicating rising market expectations for further monetary tightening.
How high can the dollar go? Markets keep a close eye on PPI data.
However, once a December hike becomes the market’s baseline expectation, whether the dollar can push beyond its recent peak will depend on upcoming economic data and Fed policy signals.
DHF Capital asset manager Bas Kooijman said that for the dollar to keep climbing, the market may need to increase its bets on a 50‑basis‑point Fed hike.

He added that if Friday’s U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) comes in above expectations, or if Fed officials continue to issue hawkish remarks, Treasury yields could rise further, propelling the dollar past its recent high.
Conversely, weaker economic data or a cooling of expectations for large rate hikes could see the dollar give back some of its gains.
It is worth noting that the U.S. Treasury market was closed on Wednesday for the Veterans Day holiday.
Euro slips below 1.11 as French debt woes add pressure.
The strong dollar continues to weigh on other major currencies.

Since the start of the year, most G10 developed‑market currencies have depreciated against the dollar, except for the Australian dollar and the Norwegian krone, reflecting the widening yield differentials between the U.S. and other economies.
Some analysts also attribute part of the dollar’s strength this year to safe‑haven flows that surged during the U.S.–Israel conflict with Iran.
The euro, in particular, feels the pressure.
The euro fell 0.65% against the dollar overnight, breaking below the 1.11‑dollar mark and extending the decline from the previous trading day, reaching its lowest level since May 2025.
In addition to the strong dollar, France’s debt problems continue to drag the euro down, and a recent pullback in oil prices has cooled expectations for European Central Bank rate hikes.
Rabobank foreign‑exchange strategist Jane Foley noted that the ECB’s last press conference revealed growing concerns among the Governing Council about the economic‑growth outlook.

She added that another factor that could suppress the euro in the coming months is the political uncertainty surrounding next year’s French presidential election; a victory by a far‑right candidate could affect the EU’s future cooperation direction.
Rabobank projects that the euro will fall further to around 1.10 against the dollar within the next three months.
As expectations for Fed rate hikes continue to rise, markets will closely monitor U.S. inflation data and Fed officials’ remarks to gauge whether the dollar still has room to strengthen further.

paras_en: The dollar rose against major currencies on Wednesday (11th), as Fed officials delivered a series of hawkish remarks and U.S. inflation data outpaced expectations, boosting the probability of a Fed rate hike next month.
The ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, climbed 0.68% to 102.90, hitting its highest level since April 2025 during the session.
The dollar strengthened 0.69% against the yen, trading at 159.84 yen, its highest level in over two months and approaching the psychological 160‑yen barrier.
The euro fell 0.65% against the dollar, trading at 1.11 dollars, continuing its decline from the previous day and reaching its lowest level since May 2025.

U.S. October consumer price inflation exceeded expectations for the third consecutive month, prompting traders to raise their bets on a Fed rate hike in December. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market’s probability of a 25‑basis‑point hike in December rose from about 70% a month ago to 87%.
Elias Haddad, Global Market Strategy Head at Brown Brothers Harriman, said that higher rate‑hike expectations help support the dollar.

Haddad added, “The dollar is broadly stronger, largely due to the shift toward hawkish Fed rate expectations. This shift is driven by October CPI data that beat forecasts, and recent Fed officials’ remarks have further amplified the trend.”

Fed officials, including Governor Christopher Waller and Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, expressed concern over persistently high inflation, with Waller even not ruling out a substantial 50‑basis‑point hike, further lifting market rate‑hike bets.

The pound fell 0.50% against the dollar, trading at 1.33 dollars, near its lowest point in two weeks. The dollar rose 0.93% against the Swiss franc, trading at 0.833 francs, briefly reaching its highest level since mid‑October.
Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank revised forecasts, expecting most major currencies to depreciate this year.

After the Tuesday inflation data release, some brokers adjusted their Fed policy outlooks. Goldman now expects rate hikes in December and March next year, while Deutsche Bank projects hikes in December, January, and March next year.

Except for the Australian dollar and Norwegian krone, most developed‑market currencies have weakened against the dollar this year, driven by widening interest‑rate spreads that lift the dollar. Some analysts also attribute the dollar’s strength to risk‑off flows during the U.S.‑Israel conflict with Iran.
The Australian dollar fell 0.23% against the dollar, trading at 0.685 dollars, while the dollar rose 0.61% against the Norwegian krone, trading at 9.55 krone.
In crypto, Bitcoin rose 0.93% to $74,460.41, and Ethereum climbed 1.19% to $2,079.31.

As of Wednesday (11th) around 6:30 a.m. Taiwan time, the dollar index was 102.9160, down 0.01%; EUR/USD was 1.1087, down 0.01%; GBP/USD was 1.3270, down 0.04%; AUD/USD was 0.6847, down 0.03%; USD/CAD was 1.4249, down 0.01%; USD/JPY was 159.68, down 0.11%.

items.title: 歐洲央行：若年底前未達協議 數位歐元推出時程恐延至2029年後
items.title_en: European Central Bank: If No Agreement by Year‑End, Digital Euro Launch Could Slip Past 2029
paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)發出警訊，指出歐盟若無法在今(2026)年底前就「單一貨幣法案包」達成協議，原定於 2029 年首次發行的數位歐元(Digital Euro)計畫恐面臨延後。
隨著 2026 年僅剩約七周時間，歐洲央行正全力敦促歐盟立法機構加快腳步，以確保整體籌備工作具備明確的法律確定性。
歐洲央行執行董事奇波洛內(Piero Cipollone)於 11 月 10 日出席歐洲議會經濟及貨幣事務委員會時明確指出，立法延宕將直接推遲數位歐元的上路時程。
奇波洛內特別提到了歐盟在基礎設施上的風險，表示目前歐元區高達三分之二的信用卡支付受控制於外國業者，並指出：「近年歐洲已深刻體會到在能源與國防上不能單純依賴第三方，支付領域也是如此。」他警告，延遲發行將加深歐洲對外國支付服務商的依賴，並打擊在地企業的創新發展空間。
同時，歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)也將數位歐元視為關鍵應對方案，並警告指出，錨定美元的私營穩定幣若大規模普及，將可能削弱央行對貨幣政策的掌控能力。
面對大眾對實體貨幣存廢的疑慮，歐洲議會官員Fernando Navarrete Rojas強調，數位歐元的定位十分清晰，「將作為現金的補充手段，絕不會取代現金。」
目前歐洲議會正與歐盟理事會及歐盟執委會展開三方協商。法案談判的核心爭議主要集中於三大面向：個人隱私保護、交易手續費架構以及個人持有限額。
若歐盟能於今年完成立法，歐洲央行預計於 2027 年下半年啟動為期 12 個月的技術試辦計畫，屆時將有 36 家市場營運商、支付服務業者及實體商家參與日常支付情境的實測。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) warned that if the EU fails to reach an agreement on the “single currency law package” by the end of this year (2026), the Digital Euro project originally slated for a first issuance in 2029 could be delayed.
With only about seven weeks left in 2026, the ECB is urging EU legislators to accelerate the process to ensure the overall preparation work has clear legal certainty.

ECB Executive Board member Piero Cipollone said on 10 November, when speaking to the European Parliament’s Committee on Economic and Monetary Affairs, that legislative delays would directly push back the timetable for the Digital Euro’s rollout.

Cipollone highlighted infrastructure risks, noting that roughly two‑thirds of euro‑area card payments are currently controlled by foreign operators, and warned that “Europe has learned in recent years that it cannot rely solely on third parties for energy and defence, and the payments sector is no different.” He cautioned that a postponed launch would deepen Europe’s reliance on foreign payment service providers and curb innovation by local firms.

ECB President Christine Lagarde also framed the Digital Euro as a key response tool, warning that a privately‑issued, dollar‑pegged stablecoin gaining widespread use could erode central banks’ control over monetary policy.

Addressing public concerns about the future of physical cash, European Parliament official Fernando Navarrete Rojas stressed that the Digital Euro’s role is clear: “It will be a complementary means to cash, never a replacement.”

The European Parliament is currently in trilateral talks with the EU Council and the European Commission. The core disputes in the legislative negotiations centre on three issues: personal data protection, transaction fee structures and individual holding limits.

If the EU completes the legislation this year, the ECB expects to launch a 12‑month technical pilot in the second half of 2027, involving 36 market operators, payment service providers and physical merchants testing everyday payment scenarios.

items.title: 美元升息預期重燃 日元跌至一個半月新低 直逼159關卡
items.title_en: Dollar Rate‑Hike Expectations Resurge, Yen Falls to One‑and‑a‑Half‑Month Low Near 159 Barrier
paras: 日元周三(11日)亞市走勢持續疲軟，兌美元匯率回落至158.97附近，盤中跌幅約0.14%，並創下9月下旬以來約一個半月的新低紀錄。
市場分析指出，美國高於預期的CPI數據激發市場對美國聯準會升息的預期，美債殖利率大幅攀升帶動美日利差擴大，吸引利差交易資金及日本進口商的實需買盤進場，進一步推低日元。
隨著通膨疑慮再起，聯準會多位官員發表鷹派言論，亦為美元提供強勁支撐。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)在通膨數據公布前即表示，若10月核心通膨達到0.3%，央行應考慮在下個月評估升息2碼(50個基點)。數據公布後，達拉斯聯邦準備銀行總裁洛根(Lorie Logan)暗示更強勁的通膨可能需要加快升息步伐；芝加哥聯邦準備銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)更直言，這份物價報告「是另一份令人不安、甚至是接近令人困擾的報告」。
面對市場迅速計入聯準會加速升息的可能性，第一生命經濟研究所經濟學家Seiji Katsurahata提出不同觀點。Katsurahata認為，市場目前對聯準會12月升息2碼的猜測顯得過度反應；隨著市場定價最終穩定在升息1碼(25個基點)，短期美債殖利率應會趨於正常化，美元匯率的上行空間預期將受限。
同時，分析師認為日本銀行(BOJ)可能必須跟進升息，以防止日元進一步走貶。日本銀行最新會議意見摘要顯示，決策官員對通膨上行風險仍保持高度警惕，並支持採取進一步升息措施。受美國國債殖利率飆升影響，日本10年期基準國債殖利率當日亦攀升至2.785%。
日元持續貶值雖提升日本出口商的盈利能力，但進口能源與原料成本上漲已顯著加重企業負擔，並引發國內消費者物價壓力。
paras_en: The yen continued its weak performance in Asian markets on Wednesday (the 11th), slipping back to around 158.97 per dollar, down about 0.14% intraday, marking a new low of about one and a half months since late September.

Market analysis points out that U.S. CPI data that came in above expectations sparked expectations of Fed rate hikes, causing U.S. Treasury yields to surge and widening the U.S.-Japan interest rate differential, attracting carry‑trade funds and genuine buying from Japanese importers, further pushing the yen lower.
With inflation concerns resurfacing, several Fed officials have made hawkish remarks, also providing strong support for the dollar.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said before the inflation data release that if core inflation hits 0.3% in October, the central bank should consider evaluating a 2‑point (50‑basis‑point) rate hike next month. After the data were released, Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan hinted that stronger inflation might require a faster pace of hikes; Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee was even more blunt, calling the price report “another unsettling, even bordering on troubling, report.”

Facing the market’s rapid pricing in of a faster Fed tightening, Seiji Katsurahata, an economist at the First Life Economic Research Institute, offered a different view. Katsurahata believes the market’s speculation that the Fed will raise rates by 2 points in December is an overreaction; as the market pricing settles at a 1‑point (25‑basis‑point) hike, short‑term Treasury yields should normalize and the upside potential for the dollar is expected to be limited.

At the same time, analysts think the Bank of Japan may have to follow suit with rate hikes to prevent further yen depreciation. The latest BOJ meeting minutes show that policymakers remain highly vigilant about inflation upside risks and support taking additional tightening measures. Affected by the surge in U.S. Treasury yields, Japan’s 10‑year benchmark government bond yield also rose to 2.785% that day.

While the yen’s continued depreciation boosts the profitability of Japanese exporters, higher import costs for energy and raw materials have significantly increased corporate burdens and sparked domestic consumer price pressures.

items.title: 香港上市債券市場重大突破 人民幣歷史性超越美元
items.title_en: Hong Kong Listed Bond Market Achieves Major Breakthrough as RMB Historically Overtakes USD
paras: 2026年前三季度，香港上市債券市場迎來歷史性轉折。信用評級機構大公國際香港最新統計顯示，以離岸人民幣計價的債券(簡稱「點心債」)占總發行額比重達37%，歷史性超越美元債券的33%，使離岸人民幣正式躍升為香港上市債券市場最大的發行幣種。
統計指出，截至2026年9月末，香港上市點心債發行規模已達2,868億元人民幣，一舉超越2025年全年總額，港交所上市發行數量達117檔，明顯多於美元債的77檔。
分析指出，在美國聯準會維持高利率背景下，美元債融資成本高企，使點心債的成本優勢更加凸顯。此外，發行主體呈現多元化與國際化趨勢，除了中資科技企業騰訊、京東與國家電網等機構外，美國安達保險、匈牙利國家儲蓄商業銀行及哈薩克國家石油天然氣公司等外資機構也積極赴港發行，顯示點心債正加速演變為全球投資者認可的離岸資產配置標竿。
針對市場新局，香港特區政府財經事務及庫務局副局長陳浩濂在交流會中明確指出，香港正「從一個金融的城市，走向金融賦能的城市」。
陳浩濂強調，金融是香港最大優勢，全球金融中心排名世界第三、亞洲第一，未來特區政府將以「金融+」為核心抓手，深化金融與科技、綠色及民生實體領域的融合，充分發揮香港作為「超級聯繫人」與「超級增值人」的角色。
發表研究報告的大公國際香港則提醒，點心債市場快速擴容的同時，仍面臨期限結構與流動性需求錯配、歐美長線資金參與深度不足，以及債匯聯動機制與風險對沖工具尚待完善等結構性挑戰。該機構強調，建構高質量的跨境信用生態，將是推動離岸人民幣債市從「規模擴張」走向「質效提升」的關鍵支撐。
paras_en: In the first three quarters of 2026, Hong Kong's listed bond market experienced a historic turning point. The latest statistics from rating agency Dagong International Hong Kong show that offshore RMB‑denominated bonds (commonly called “dim sum bonds”) accounted for 37% of total issuance, a historic overtaking of USD bonds at 33%, making offshore RMB the largest currency for issuance in Hong Kong’s listed bond market.

The data indicate that by the end of September 2026, the issuance volume of Hong Kong‑listed dim sum bonds had reached RMB 286.8 billion, surpassing the entire 2025 annual total. A total of 117 dim sum bond issues were listed on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, clearly outnumbering the 77 USD‑denominated issues.

Analysts point out that, with the U.S. Federal Reserve maintaining high interest rates, the financing cost of USD bonds remains elevated, highlighting the cost advantage of dim sum bonds. Moreover, issuers are becoming more diversified and international: besides Chinese tech giants such as Tencent and JD.com and state‑owned entities like State Grid, foreign institutions such as U.S. insurer AIG, Hungary’s National Savings Commercial Bank and Kazakhstan’s National Oil and Gas Company are actively issuing in Hong Kong, indicating that dim sum bonds are rapidly evolving into a globally recognised offshore asset‑allocation benchmark.

Regarding the new market dynamics, Hong Kong SAR Government Deputy Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury, Chan Ho‑lin, said at a briefing that Hong Kong is moving “from a financial city to a financially‑empowered city.”

Chan Ho‑lin stressed that finance is Hong Kong’s greatest advantage, ranking third worldwide and first in Asia as a global financial centre. The SAR government will centre its strategy on “Finance+,” deepening the integration of finance with technology, green initiatives and real‑economy sectors, fully leveraging Hong Kong’s role as a “super connector” and “super value‑adder.”

Dagong International Hong Kong, which released the research report, warned that while the dim sum bond market is expanding rapidly, it still faces structural challenges such as mismatches between maturity structure and liquidity demand, insufficient participation from long‑term European and American capital, and underdeveloped bond‑FX linkage mechanisms and hedging tools. The agency stressed that building a high‑quality cross‑border credit ecosystem will be key to moving the offshore RMB bond market from “scale expansion” to “quality and efficiency improvement.”
